” Virginia Blanco - Google Review Read All 188 Reviews → Investor Questions Everything You Need to Know Buying property overseas is a serious decision that deserves straight answers.
We cover the main questions below.
For anything else, our team is on WhatsApp and replies as quickly as possible, allowing for Bali time.
Who am I buying from?
+ Balitecture, as the developer.
Your sale and purchase agreement (PPJB) is with Balitecture and you receive a finished villa; you do not contract a builder yourself.
Balitecture designs the villa, manages construction through to handover, and runs the rental afterwards if you take up management.
Can foreigners legally own property in Bali?
+ Yes - through a leasehold (Hak Sewa) structure.
Foreign nationals cannot hold freehold title in Indonesia, but a properly structured long-term lease gives you full use rights, rental rights, and resale rights for the lease duration.
Nara Villas offers a 30-year lease with a 30-year extension option, giving 60 years of ownership from a single contract.
This is the most common and legally sound structure for international investors in Bali.
What is a leasehold and how does it work?
+ A leasehold gives you exclusive rights to use and profit from the property for a fixed period - in Nara's case, 30 years with an option to extend for a further 30 years.
You own the building outright.
You lease the land it sits on.
This is how most of the best-known villa resorts in Bali operate.
The land lease is registered with a notary and protected under Indonesian property law.
What happens when the 30-year lease expires?
+ Your purchase contract includes a 30-year extension option, which gives you the right to renew on pre-agreed terms.
In practice, most leaseholds are renewed long before expiry.
Bali's property market has seen very consistent extension rates because both parties benefit - the landowner from continued income, the investor from protecting their asset.
Balitecture's legal team structures every contract with this in mind.
Is my investment legally protected if the developer doesn't deliver?
+ Yes.

Your purchase is governed by a PPJB (Perjanjian Pengikatan Jual Beli) - Indonesia's equivalent of a binding sale and purchase agreement - which sets out the construction specifications, completion timeline, and compensation terms.
Balitecture is SIUP-4 licensed and an AREBI member.
We've designed and delivered 200+ villas in Bali.
Our track record is verifiable and our contracts are drawn up by qualified Indonesian notaries.
Can I buy remotely without visiting Bali?
+ Completely.
A number of Nara buyers have completed their purchase from Australia, Europe and the US without travelling to Bali.
The reservation, contracts, and payments can all be handled remotely via WhatsApp, email, and international transfer.
If you'd like to visit before committing, we arrange guided site visits - but it's not a requirement.
How does rental management work - and what does it cost?
+ Balitecture's property management team handles everything: guest bookings across Airbnb and Booking.com, cleaning, maintenance, check-ins, and monthly reporting.
The management fee is 15% of gross rental revenue - deducted before your monthly payout.
You receive a detailed statement each month.
You can also opt out of management and self-manage if you prefer.
What taxes apply to rental income?
+ Rental income from Bali property is subject to Indonesian income tax - typically a flat 10% final tax on gross income for non-residents.
You will likely also have a reporting obligation in your home country; most investors use a local accountant who specialises in overseas property.
Balitecture can refer you to advisors familiar with the Bali structure.
Tax treatment varies by country - this is general guidance, not advice.
Can I sell the villa before the lease expires?
Leasehold villas in Bali are bought and sold routinely.
The buyer acquires the remaining lease term.
Demand for well-located, well-designed villas in Uluwatu is strong - particularly as Pink Zone supply tightens.
Many investors hold for 3-5 years after completion and exit at a significant premium to their purchase price.
How long after completion before I start earning rental income?
+ Most villas begin earning income within 4-8 weeks of handover.
That window allows for final furnishing, photography, listing setup, and the first confirmed bookings.
Balitecture's rental team begins marketing your villa before completion so the calendar fills quickly.
You won't be waiting months for your first payout.
What's included in the price - are there additional purchase costs?
+ The listed price covers the villa including all standard inclusions (pool, kitchen, built-in joinery, appliances).
Purchase costs in Indonesia are minimal compared to Western markets - typically 2.5-5% for notary fees and title registration.
There are no stamp duties or agent commissions on the buyer side.
The full breakdown is provided during the purchase process.

The Greater Uluwatu region maintains its pristine forests and avoids mass development due to its unique zoning regulations.
The designated tourist zone, ideal for high-end hotel construction, is restricted to a narrow coastal strip within 300 metres of the ocean.

This preservation is what makes our landscape so unique.

How Much Does Property in Bali Cost in 2026?

Apartment Prices in Bali in 2026 How much does property in Bali cost?

How to Buy Real Estate in Bali as a Foreigner What Foreigners Need to Know in 2026 to Buy Real Estate in Bali Interest in Bali real estate remains strong, but so does the number of questions from international buyers.
Today, people are looking beyond the price of a villa, flat, or off-plan apartments in Bali.
They also want to understand how the purchase process works, which ownership options are available to foreigners, and what costs to expect before and after signing the contract.
If you plan to buy real estate in Bali as a foreigner, it is important to know that the legal framework differs significantly from many European countries.
Foreigners can legally purchase property in Bali, but they cannot own land under freehold title in their own name.

Before choosing a property, it is worth understanding: whether foreigners can buy property in Bali and which ownership structures are available; how the transaction works from selecting a property to completing the legal documentation; the total cost of purchasing property, including additional fees; which property taxes should be taken into account; which legal documents should be verified before paying a deposit.
In 2026, the key question is no longer simply which villa to choose.
It is how to structure the transaction in a transparent, secure way that matches your investment goals.
Can Foreigners Buy Property in Bali?
One of the first questions buyers ask is whether a foreigner can purchase a villa or apartment in Bali and register it in their own name.
The short answer is yes, but Bali real estate for foreigners is subject to specific legal restrictions and ownership rules.
Foreigners cannot obtain Hak Milik, the Indonesian freehold title available only to Indonesian citizens.
This is why the common phrase "buying a villa in Bali" is not the same as owning land under Indonesian law.
Foreign buyers can use the property, invest in it, rent it out, or transfer their rights, but only within the legal ownership structures available to them.

In practice, foreigners can buy property in Bali through several legal options: Leasehold — a long-term lease of land or property; Hak Pakai — the right to use a property; PT PMA — acquiring eligible property rights and conducting commercial activities through a foreign-owned company registered in Indonesia.
The right option depends on your investment goals.
One ownership structure may be suitable for a private residence, another for a rental business, and another for long-term investment or resale.
That is why, before signing a purchase agreement, it is essential to evaluate not only the property, location, and price but also the legal rights you will receive after the transaction is completed.

Bali Real Estate for Foreigners: Available Ownership Options For foreign buyers, purchasing property in Bali is typically based on either a legal right to use the property or ownership through a specific legal structure.
The option you choose determines how long you can hold the property, whether you can rent it out, and the conditions for selling or transferring your rights in the future.
It is important to distinguish between the three main ownership structures: Leasehold, Hak Pakai, and PT PMA.
These are not different versions of the same purchase method but separate legal mechanisms with different rights, timeframes, restrictions, and purposes.
Leasehold: Long-Term Lease Leasehold is one of the most common options in Bali real estate for foreigners.
In practice, it is a long-term lease of land or a property rather than freehold ownership.
There is no standard lease term for every transaction.
While agreements of 25–30 years are common, the exact duration is negotiated between the parties and specified in the contract.
This option is suitable for buyers who plan to use the property as a private residence, a holiday home, or a rental investment.
However, the lease agreement itself is the most important document in the transaction.

Before signing, make sure to review: the lease term; extension conditions; the cost of extending the lease; whether the lease rights can be transferred to another buyer; restrictions on the use of the property; what happens to the building when the lease expires; the responsibilities of each party.
Leasehold can be a practical ownership structure, but its security depends largely on the quality of the contract and proper legal due diligence.
Hak Pakai: Registered Right of Use Hak Pakai is a registered right to use property in Indonesia.
It may be available to foreign buyers who meet specific legal requirements, including holding the appropriate immigration documents and having a valid legal status in Indonesia.
Hak Pakai is generally intended for buyers who want to use the property primarily as their private residence or for personal purposes.
It is important to understand that the right to use a property does not automatically grant the right to operate it as a short-term rental or commercial investment.
If your goal is to rent out a villa, this should be verified before completing the purchase with a qualified lawyer, notary, or licensed property consultant in Indonesia.
They should review the property's legal documentation, land zoning, permitted land use, ownership registration, and whether the required licenses for rental activities can be obtained.
Otherwise, you may discover that the property is perfectly suitable for private use but cannot legally be rented to tourists.
Hak Pakai may provide stronger legal protection than a standard lease agreement.
However, if your objective is Bali real estate investment or generating rental income, this ownership structure should be evaluated carefully.
In many cases, another legal structure, such as PT PMA, may be more appropriate.
PT PMA: Buying Property Through a Company PT PMA is an Indonesian company with foreign ownership.
Through this legal entity, foreign investors can acquire eligible property rights and conduct commercial activities in Indonesia.
For those planning to buy real estate in Bali as a foreigner, PT PMA is not a way to "buy a villa in your own name." It is a business structure designed for commercial operations.
This option may be suitable if you plan to rent out the property, manage rental income, or hold it as an investment asset.
It is important to understand that establishing a PT PMA does not grant a foreigner Hak Milik (freehold ownership of land).
This title is available only to Indonesian citizens.
A PT PMA can hold only those property rights that are permitted under Indonesian law.
For a rental business, registering a PT PMA alone is not enough.
It is also essential to verify the company's business activities, required licenses, land zoning, permits, and whether the property rights have been structured correctly.
For this reason, a PT PMA can be an effective solution for implementing a commercial investment strategy, but it is not always necessary for purchasing property for private use.

Step-by-Step Process to Buy Property in Bali To buy real estate in Bali safely, it is important to view the process not as a quick property selection, but as a structured transaction supported by proper legal due diligence.
Most mistakes happen not when choosing a villa or apartment, but when buyers rush to pay a deposit or do not fully understand the ownership structure.
The process typically includes the following steps: Define your investment goal.
A property for personal use, rental income, long-term investment, or resale may require different legal structures.
Choose the location and budget.

At this stage, it is important not only to understand property prices in Bali but also to calculate the total cost of the transaction, including the property type, ownership structure, project stage, taxes, legal fees, and future maintenance costs.
Select the appropriate ownership structure.
Determine whether Leasehold, Hak Pakai, or PT PMA best fits your objectives.
Conduct legal due diligence.
Verify the land title, ownership documents, permits, zoning regulations, and the developer's reputation.
Review the purchase agreement and payment terms.
Pay particular attention to the deposit, completion timeline, lease extension terms, transfer of rights, and the responsibilities of each party.
Sign the transaction documents before a notary or PPAT.
Pay the applicable taxes and government fees.
Receive the final ownership documents and, if the property is intended for rental income, arrange professional property management.
Following this process helps you evaluate not only the property's investment potential but also the legal security of the transaction.

Bali Real Estate Investment: Taxes and Costs Every Buyer Should Consider One of the first questions buyers ask is: "can foreigners buy property in Bali?" Once they have the answer, many focus primarily on the purchase price.
In reality, the total cost of ownership goes far beyond the price of a villa or apartment and includes legal fees, due diligence, taxes, and ongoing maintenance expenses.
It is important to understand that Bali property tax is not a single, universal payment.

Property-related costs may arise at different stages of ownership: when acquiring property rights, during the transfer of ownership, throughout the ownership period, and when generating rental income.

Buyers should typically take the following costs into account: taxes or government fees payable when acquiring property rights; taxes related to the transfer of property; notary and registration fees; legal due diligence costs; annual land and property tax; VAT, where applicable to the transaction; rental income tax, if the property is leased; property management fees; maintenance, repairs, and utility expenses.

A property may appear attractive based on its purchase price alone, but after taxes, management fees, and ongoing maintenance costs are factored in, the actual return on investment may be lower than expected.
For this reason, it is advisable to calculate the full financial model before signing the purchase agreement.
Before completing a transaction, buyers should also clarify which taxes and fees apply to their chosen ownership structure, whether Leasehold, Hak Pakai, or PT PMA.
The ownership format affects not only the upfront transaction costs but also future tax obligations.

Documents to Check Before You Buy Real Estate in Bali in 2026 Before paying a deposit, it is essential to verify not only the property itself but also the legal documentation related to the land, permits, seller, and future ownership costs.

If you plan to buy real estate in Bali, many of the biggest risks are linked to the legal aspects of the transaction, as well as whether Bali property taxes and other mandatory fees have been properly assessed in advance.

Before proceeding with the purchase, make sure to review: the land certificate and its registration with the Indonesian Land Agency (BPN); the PBG (Building Approval Permit); the SLF (Certificate of Building Worthiness); documents confirming the property's zoning and permitted land use; the seller's or developer's legal documentation; the developer's corporate documents, if purchasing an off-plan property; the Leasehold agreement and its extension terms; documents confirming whether the ownership or lease rights can be transferred; confirmation that the property is free from mortgages, legal disputes, or other encumbrances; certificates confirming there are no outstanding tax liabilities; documents confirming legal road access to the property; rental permits or licenses, if the property is intended as an investment.
It is always better to identify these issues before making a payment than to discover legal restrictions or unexpected limitations after the transaction has already been completed.

Buy Real Estate in Bali: What to Check When Purchasing Off-Plan Apartments in Bali Many investors choose to buy real estate in Bali during the construction stage because prices are often more attractive than for completed properties.
However, off-plan purchases also involve additional risks.
Buyers should evaluate not only the price, layout, and location but also the developer's documentation, the purchase agreement, and the responsibilities of each party.

Before purchasing an off-plan property, make sure to review: the developer's legal rights to the land; construction permits; the expected construction timeline; the payment schedule; penalties for construction delays; the property's specifications and inclusions; warranties; refund conditions.
The purchase agreement deserves particular attention.
It should clearly specify what exactly the buyer is purchasing, when the property will be delivered, what is included in the purchase price, and what happens if construction is delayed.
When buying an off-plan property, do not rely solely on project presentations or sales promises.
All key terms and obligations should be documented before paying a deposit or making the first installment.
Bali Real Estate Investment: Is 2026 the Right Time to Enter the Market?
Bali real estate investment can be an attractive opportunity in 2026 if approached as a carefully planned long-term strategy.

Buyers should evaluate not only the purchase price but also the ownership structure, taxes, projected returns, location, property liquidity, exit strategy, and the reputation of the developer in Bali.
The Bali property market continues to mature, making careful due diligence more important than ever.

For anyone planning to buy real estate in Bali as a foreigner, understanding the ownership structure, calculating the true cost of ownership, and developing a clear strategy for using the property are just as important as choosing the right location or developer.

Investors looking to minimize purchase and maintenance expenses will find apartments to be an optimal choice.
Minimal Maintenance and Clean Living Space One key aspect that sets apartments apart from villas and townhouses in Bali is the absence of certain “wildlife” that may appear in private yards.
Since apartments lack large open spaces, owners don’t have to worry about unwanted “neighbors” like snakes, geckos, frogs, and other animals common to greener and more open areas.
Investors and renters who prefer a clean environment will find apartments much more comfortable for living.
Convenient Underground Parking and Access to Modern Amenities Modern apartment complexes in Bali offer essential amenities that make everyday living more comfortable and secure.
For instance, underground parking provides vehicle safety and shields them from weather conditions, which is particularly important in a tropical climate.
A concierge service offers assistance with household matters, leisure arrangements, and general upkeep of the complex.
Amenities such as swimming pools, co-working spaces, fitness centers, and relaxation zones make apartments more desirable on the rental market.
High Rental Demand and Stable Income Bali’s popularity among tourists and expats remains consistently high, and apartments on the island attract renters year-round.
Digital nomads, tourists, and expats increasingly choose compact and functional apartments.
For property owners, this translates into steady income and high occupancy rates even during the low season.
Low Maintenance Costs Apartments incur lower maintenance costs compared to villas and townhouses.
The management company handles landscaping, cleaning, technical maintenance, and security.
This frees owners from extra hassles and ensures the property remains in good condition.
Additionally, saving on maintenance does not reduce the property's appeal, as renters receive all necessary amenities and services without needing to maintain them themselves.
High Liquidity and Growth Prospects The liquidity of apartments in Bali's real estate market allows investors to manage assets flexibly and quickly sell the property if needed.
Smaller size, more affordable price, and high demand make apartments attractive for resale, providing an opportunity to increase capital as prices rise.
As Canggu and other popular areas in Bali continue to develop, the value of apartments grows each year.
Ease of Transaction and Minimal Legal Risks In Bali, restrictions on full land ownership for foreign nationals can complicate the purchase of villas or townhouses.
With apartments, the process is much simpler: they can be purchased through a long-term leasehold, which doesn’t require complex legal structures.
This simplifies the purchase procedure and reduces risks associated with owning property in a foreign country.
Conclusion Apartments in Bali combine affordability, comfort, and the potential for successful investment.
Freedom from property maintenance, minimal concerns about wildlife, underground parking, and concierge service make them ideal for living and renting.
These benefits allow investors to enjoy a stable income while preserving the asset’s liquidity and value.
Why Investing in Canggu is Profitable Over the past few years, Canggu has become one of Bali’s most attractive destinations for property investors.
Its rapidly expanding infrastructure, steady flow of visitors and distinctive lifestyle appeal continue to attract local residents, expatriates and travellers from around the world.
In this article, we explore why Canggu is considered one of Bali’s most promising areas for property investment, particularly for apartments.
Rapid Infrastructure Development Canggu has changed significantly in recent years.
Once known as a quiet coastal area, it is now a thriving neighbourhood with a growing selection of restaurants, cafés, fitness clubs and coworking spaces.
This development has made the area increasingly attractive to both visitors and long-term residents.
Many modern apartment developments are located close to shops, gyms, cafés and other essential services, which helps them remain highly competitive in the rental market.
Strong Rental Demand Bali attracts visitors and expatriates throughout the year, and Canggu remains one of the island’s most sought-after areas.
Demand is strong for both short-term and long-term rentals, particularly apartments.
Tenants are drawn to the area by its proximity to the beach, well-developed infrastructure and vibrant social scene.
A consistent flow of renters allows apartments in Canggu to generate a stable rental income.
Attractive Returns and a Relatively Short Payback Period Property investments in Canggu can offer attractive returns.
Apartments in the area may generate average rental yields of approximately 10–15% per year, making Canggu one of Bali’s more profitable investment locations.
With rental demand remaining high, investors may recover their initial investment within approximately 7–10 years while continuing to earn regular income from the property.
Potential for Property Value Growth Canggu continues to develop while maintaining its position as one of Bali’s most desirable areas.
Consistent demand supports the local property market and creates favourable conditions for further price growth.
An apartment in Canggu can therefore serve as a long-term asset that generates rental income while potentially increasing in value over time.
A Lifestyle That Appeals to Renters Canggu attracts people looking for a balance between relaxed coastal living and an active lifestyle.
The area offers peaceful places to unwind alongside restaurants, cafés, fitness clubs and a lively social scene.
This combination appeals to a broad range of renters, supports steady demand for apartments and helps maintain their long-term investment appeal.

Who is the developer?
ESM Company Group: a developer, general contractor and hotel operator in Phuket since 2016.
Where is the project, and how far is it from the beach?
Karon, Phuket; about 15 minutes on foot to Karon Beach, plus a beach shuttle for residents.
How is it different from Vibe Residence Karon?
It's a separate project by the same developer: 299 apartments, sales launch in Q4 2026, completion in Q4 2029, early pre-sale prices.
How much do the apartments cost?
Studios from $86,000, one bedroom from $109,000, one-bedroom plus from $129,000, two bedrooms from $169,000.

Is an instalment plan available?
Yes.

One-off: freehold title — 12,000 THB per m², sinking fund — 700 THB per m², transfer fee — 1% of the price, water and electricity meters — 20,000 THB.

When do sales start, and when is completion expected?

Foreign buyers can own condominium apartments freehold, subject to the foreign ownership quota.
Can I buy remotely?

The developer offers rental management, including listings on Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda and other platforms, guest stays and income reports.

A rooftop infinity pool and garden, a second pool by the lobby lounge, a café, co-working space and meeting room, a gym, sauna and steam room, a cinema, games room and children's playroom, a padel court, a beach shuttle and parking for 98 cars.

Studios of 26–28 m², one bedroom of 33–35 m², one-bedroom plus of 39–46 m², two bedrooms of 51–52 m².

Por su territorio discurre el Río Verde, que antes de llegar al embalse de La Concepción atraviesa parajes excepcionales.
En medio de este paraíso se enclavan dos núcleos residenciales diferenciados.
Por un lado, el pueblo de Istán en lo alto de la montaña, repleto de fuentes, miradores y rincones pintorescos.

Y por otro lado, la zona de las urbanizaciones internacionales, que se ubican más próximas a Marbella, a 8 kilómetros del pueblo de Istán y a 6 kilómetros de Nueva Andalucía donde se ubican Almazara, Cerros del Lago, Balcones del Lago, Zahara de Istán y Sierra Blanca Country Club.

El colegio internacional Aloha y la discoteca Olivia Velere se encuentran a 10 minutos en coche de Almazara Hills.

ENVIAR --> Características Galería de imágenes Localización Zeta Valley Fecha prevista de entrega: 4 TR 2026 Zeta Valley es una promoción exclusiva que combina un estilo de vida moderno, ecológico y eficiente, situada en el exclusivo y emergente Distrito Zeta, a pocos pasos de la estación de tren.

Con un diseño innovador, Zeta Valley está concebida para integrar la naturaleza en el día a día, ofreciendo huertos urbanos, sistemas energéticos renovables en las calles, y un enfoque integral hacia la sostenibilidad y la movilidad inteligente.
El complejo consta de 67 viviendas de 1, 2 y 3 dormitorios, todas con calificación energética A, lo que las convierte en una de las opciones más sostenibles y eficientes del mercado.

Además, Zeta Valley ofrece extraordinarias zonas comunes que incluyen amplias piscinas, jardines amplios, espacios de recreo para niños y mascotas, una sala multiuso y mobiliario urbano para disfrutar en familia.

Con una ubicación estratégica, Zeta Valley ofrece conexiones inmejorables: está a tan solo 10 minutos de Málaga Capital y del aeropuerto internacional, y tiene acceso directo a la autovía en todas direcciones.
También cuenta con excelentes conexiones de transporte público y está rodeada de servicios, comercios, restaurantes y centros de ocio y deporte, sin necesidad de salir de tu barrio inteligente.
Zeta Valley es la oportunidad de vivir en una comunidad diseñada para el futuro, donde la tecnología, la sostenibilidad y el bienestar conviven para ofrecerte un hogar único.

Financiador Descripción Blue Wave: ¡Proyecto en construcción!
Un conjunto residencial pensado para disfrutar de la luz, el paisaje y una forma de vivir conectada con el mar.
Disfruta de: • Piscina comunitaria.
• Gimnasio.
• Espacio de coworking.
• Zonas comunes ajardinadas.
La promoción cuenta con 66 viviendas adosadas de 3 dormitorios, diseñadas para ofrecer amplitud, funcionalidad y una relación abierta con el exterior.
Destacan sus grandes terrazas con vistas al Mediterráneo y, en las viviendas de esquina, los amplios jardines con piscina individual.
Todas las viviendas incluyen plaza de aparcamiento y el conjunto dispone de extensas zonas comunes.

Ubicada en un enclave privilegiado de la Costa del Sol, Blue Wave se sitúa muy próxima a Sotogrande, rodeada de campos de golf y puertos deportivos, y bien conectada con Gibraltar, Estepona, Puerto Banús y Marbella.

En línea con su apuesta por la sostenibilidad y el confort, este residencial cuenta con calificación energética A tanto en consumo de energía primaria no renovable como en emisiones de CO₂, además de Sello Verde, Compromiso Domum y Análisis de Ciclo de Vida (ACV), incorporando soluciones orientadas a la eficiencia energética, la gestión responsable de los recursos hídricos y la reducción del impacto ambiental.

This event holds significant importance in the project's development timeline, marking the milestone of completing the entire structural phase as scheduled, and entering the finishing stage in preparation for handover to customers.

"Rapid" Progress Demonstrating Superior Capability Officially commencing construction in March 2024, the developer from Malaysia has aggressively executed Eaton Park, aiming to complete the topping-out of all six towers on or ahead of schedule.

Following this topping-out milestone, the developer will mobilize resources to focus on the detailed interior finishing of the apartments as well as the landscape infrastructure and internal amenities.

Every process is strictly monitored under the international GQUAS quality control standard system established by Gamuda Land itself, targeting the delivery of perfect homes to customers starting from Q3/2027.

Strong Appeal from a Real Estate Project Setting Impressive Sales Records Located at a prime gateway location on the eastern side leading into central Ho Chi Minh City, directly fronting Mai Chi Tho Boulevard, Eaton Park is expected to become a prominent contemporary architectural landmark in the region.
Spanning a total area of 3.7 hectares, this luxury apartment complex is planned with six grand towers ranging from 29 to 39 stories, offering 2,052 diverse real estate products to the market.

These range from a premium residential collection including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses; to a unique riverside commercial street comprising a retail podium system and valuable shophouse rows.
Notably, the Lagoon and Cove towers that were just topped out represent the most premium versions of Eaton Park, fully embodying the essence of this "elite benchmark" project.

The design of Eaton Park strongly reflects delicate Biophilic architectural marks, harmoniously connecting people with nature through sweeping views of the lush green canal or towards the city center.
Homeowners here enjoy exclusive, unlimited access to a system of over 100 international-standard internal amenities, fully meeting the diverse needs of residents across various age groups.
Every interior detail inside the apartments is meticulously crafted with imported home appliances from international brands.
It is the outstanding intrinsic quality of the product, combined with the developer's superior sales policies, that has enabled Eaton Park to continuously set unprecedented liquidity records.

Through three launches, the project consistently maintained a record of filling 90% of its inventory within just a few hours of release, with all products completely sold out within one month thereafter, creating "earthquakes" in the Ho Chi Minh City real estate market in particular and the Southern region in general.
Possessing superior intrinsic qualities, Eaton Park is not only well-received by the market but also recognized through numerous prestigious awards.
>>See details of Eaton Park products and amenities The project is further backed by prestigious domestic and international awards.

In 2024, Eaton Park achieved a double victory by winning six major apartment categories at the Vietnam Property Awards and making a regional mark with two prestigious titles at the Asia Property Awards.
Strategic Vision and Gamuda Land's Era of Breakthroughs Speaking at the topping-out event, Mr.

Teoh Chin Siang – General Director of Gamuda Land Vietnam (Southern Region 1), shared: "Eaton Park is a flagship luxury project for Gamuda Land in Eastern HCMC, serving as a key step in our QTP strategy to expand scale in Vietnam.

Therefore, today's milestone of completing the structural construction phase holds immense significance, serving as a solid foundation for us to continue expanding and creating even more exemplary residential projects in the future." As a subsidiary of Gamuda Berhad – Malaysia's leading construction and infrastructure development group, Gamuda Land is a real estate developer with over three decades of global project execution experience since its founding in 1995.
This foreign giant officially entered the Vietnamese market in 2007.

Starting with large-scale green township projects such as the 274-hectare Gamuda City in Hanoi and the 82-hectare Celadon City in HCMC, Gamuda Land has gradually transformed the suburban planning landscape, redefining the concept of sustainable eco-living spaces, and contributing to the creation of modern, vibrant satellite urban areas.

After nearly two decades of reinforcing its pioneering position in Vietnam through these two model projects, the leading Malaysian developer is rapidly accelerating its scale with a product portfolio diversification strategy, ranging from integrated townships to Quick Turnaround Projects (QTP).
To date, the enterprise has implemented a total of 11 large and small projects nationwide.
Norton Park – a luxury apartment complex by Gamuda Land in Thuan Giao Ward, HCMC, expected to launch in Q4/2026, promises to continue stirring up the regional market.
Among these, the most notable are the projects being actively prepared for launch in the former Binh Duong area – now designated to become a key economic region north of HCMC.

Expected to "debut" by the end of this year, these high-rise residential and commercial complexes are anticipated by experts to bring fresh momentum, sparking the next waves of liquidity "earthquakes." Krrish Square project’s future remains in limbo | The Morning 3rd November, 2026 සිංහල | தமிழ் | E Paper Search Sign In Krrish Square project’s future remains in limbo 26 Jul 2026 | By Shenal Fernando Krrish Square project’s future remains in limbo 26 Jul 2026 | By Shenal Fernando Developer undergoes liquidation before Commercial High Court of Colombo Leasehold right to project land to be sold to new investor UDA has no intention to take back land The future of the Krrish Square project remains in limbo while its developer, Krrish Transworks Colombo Ltd., undergoes liquidation before the Commercial High Court of Colombo, with the leasehold right to the project land expected to be sold to a new investor through the liquidation process.

Speaking to The Sunday Morning Business , a high-ranking source from the Urban Development Authority (UDA), on condition of anonymity, revealed that the future of the Krrish project remained in limbo while Krrish Transworks Colombo, the developer of the Krrish Square project, underwent liquidation.
Responding to a query, he claimed that the liquidator could sell the leasehold right to the land, granted by the UDA to the developer, to a new investor within the liquidation process.
“The leasehold right can be sold, since it is done by the court,” he stated.
However, he stated that he was unaware whether any investors had expressed an interest to the liquidator to purchase the leasehold right.

Responding to queries on whether the UDA intended to take back the land, he stated that the authority had no intention of doing so, adding that it would instead wait for a new investor to be identified and granted the project by the liquidator through the liquidation process.

In response to questions on whether the UDA had a timeline within which the project could be recommenced, he stated: “Krrish is undergoing the liquidation process, so it is difficult to set a timeline.” The Krrish Transworks Colombo liquidation stems from an action instituted by a major creditor before the Commercial High Court of Colombo seeking to compulsorily wind up the company.
The Commercial High Court thereafter made an order winding up the company on or around August 2024.
The developer, Krrish Transworks Colombo, the local company of the Krrish Group, entered into a lease agreement with the UDA in 2012 for 99 years at Rs.
5 billion for the Krrish Square project.
The proposed development was expected to be a large-scale mixed development consisting of high-end residential towers, commercial and retail spaces, and a seven-star hotel.
It was also to contain the Transworks Building, a heritage site, which was to retain its architectural character and be converted into a luxury boutique hotel.

Developed by North Home Company Limited under the trusted Ornsirin Group, the project focuses on elegant city living with strong emphasis on wellbeing , greenery , safety , and long-term value.
The project consists of a single 16-storey residential building with 421 units on approximately 5.22 rai of land.

Astra Infinite is positioned within one of Chiang Mai’s most established lifestyle zones, only minutes from the Night Bazaar, Chiang Mai International Airport, hospitals, shopping malls, cafés, and cultural attractions.

Astra Infinite stands out for its premium wellness-oriented design , featuring earthquake-resistant engineering , advanced Flow & Fine Air Filtration systems , rooftop lifestyle facilities, extensive green spaces, and elevated flood protection measures.
The development is also targeting Green Building standards with energy-saving materials and environmental efficiency integrated throughout the project.

Astra Infinite – Unit Types Studio at Astra Infinite Studio units offer approximately 29–30 sqm of usable living space, ideal for single professionals, digital nomads, and investors seeking efficient city residences with low maintenance and strong rental appeal.
The layout includes a sleeping area, compact kitchen, bathroom, and living space with full furnishing packages available.
1 Bedroom at Astra Infinite The 1 Bedroom units range from approximately 34–36 sqm and are designed for couples and long-stay residents seeking comfortable urban living.
The layouts provide a separate bedroom, modern kitchen area, and spacious living zone with high ceilings that enhance openness and natural airflow.
1 Bedroom Plus at Astra Infinite Ranging from approximately 37–40 sqm , the 1 Bedroom Plus units include an additional flexible room that can function as a home office, guest room, or study area.
These units are particularly attractive for remote workers and lifestyle buyers seeking extra functionality within a compact footprint.
2 Bedroom at Astra Infinite The 2 Bedroom residences offer approximately 56–57 sqm of living space with two bathrooms, suitable for small families or buyers seeking larger city residences.
Layouts include open-plan living and dining areas with enhanced privacy between bedrooms.
3 Bedroom at Astra Infinite The 3 Bedroom residences range from approximately 94–96 sqm and represent the largest unit category within the development.
Designed for families and long-term residents, these layouts provide spacious living areas, multiple bathrooms, large kitchens, and panoramic city or mountain views.

Design & Lifestyle and Facilities at Astra Infinite Astra Infinite embraces a modern Colonial Lanna architectural style , combining timeless elegance, contemporary comfort, and inspiration from Chiang Mai’s rich cultural heritage.
Warm natural textures, refined detailing, and sophisticated architectural lines create a welcoming yet luxurious atmosphere throughout the project.

Interiors are thoughtfully designed with soft neutral palettes , wood-inspired finishes , premium porcelain and ceramic materials , and generous 2.7-meter ceiling heights that enhance natural light and spaciousness in every residence.
The project is carefully designed to support wellness-focused living while integrating sustainable and smart home technologies for greater comfort and efficiency.

Residents benefit from advanced features including Flow & Fine Air Filtration systems , earthquake-resistant structural engineering , elevated flood prevention design , Green Building standards , energy-saving insulated glass , reflective roofing systems , low-flow sanitary ware , and advanced ventilation systems .
Every unit also comes fully equipped with digital door locks , Wi-Fi support systems , air-conditioning units , and water heaters for complete modern convenience.
Astra Infinite further enhances the residential experience through thoughtfully designed resort-style lifestyle facilities surrounded by landscaped greenery.

Residents enjoy an extensive collection of premium amenities including a grand luxury lobby , Rooftop Horizon Pool , Skyline Fitness Center , Yoga Room , Sky Lounge , co-working space , meeting rooms , sauna rooms , and versatile multi-purpose rooms .
The project also features beautifully landscaped gardens across Levels 1, 3, and the rooftop , alongside reading areas and peaceful relaxation spaces.

Complementing the development are approximately 2,224 sqm of integrated green spaces , creating a calm, nature-inspired environment that enhances privacy, tranquility, and the overall quality of modern luxury living in Chiang Mai.

Location & Nearby Amenities at Astra Infinite Astra Infinite is strategically located on Chang Klan Road , one of Chiang Mai’s most desirable and well-connected central districts, offering convenient access to the city’s major commercial, lifestyle, and tourism destinations.
The location combines urban convenience with strong long-term investment appeal, making it ideal for both residential living and property investment in Chiang Mai.

For recreation and outdoor living, the area provides access to renowned golf courses such as North Hill Golf Club , Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai , and Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Spa Resort , as well as natural attractions including Doi Suthep–Pui National Park and nearby mountain landscapes.

Adding further value to the location, the surrounding Chang Klan area is undergoing significant transformation through the new Lannatique mixed-use development , a landmark cultural and retail destination valued at nearly THB 12 billion , further strengthening the area’s future growth potential and long-term investment prospects.
Who Is Astra Infinite For?
Astra Infinite is ideal for lifestyle buyers, professionals, retirees, digital nomads, and long-term investors seeking a luxury city residence in one of Chiang Mai’s strongest growth areas.
The project particularly appeals to buyers who value wellness-oriented living , elegant design, strong infrastructure, and convenient access to both city amenities and cultural attractions.

The larger 2 Bedroom and 3 Bedroom layouts are especially suitable for families and long-stay residents, while the smaller unit types offer attractive opportunities for rental investment and short-to-medium term leasing demand.

The project benefits from several key investment drivers including convenient access to Chiang Mai International Airport , proximity to the Night Bazaar and the emerging Lannatique mixed-use district , a growing international resident community, and increasing demand for premium urban residences.

Developed by a reputable local developer with a proven track record, Astra Infinite also offers freehold ownership with foreign ownership quota available up to 49% of the total saleable area, making it especially attractive for overseas investors seeking long-term asset security in Thailand.

Strong rental potential is expected from long-stay expatriates , digital nomads , medical tourists , airline and hospitality professionals , retirees , and the growing demand for short-to-medium term executive rentals in central Chiang Mai.

Blending an authentic Mediterranean lifestyle with premium residential offerings and Montenegro’s first 18-hole golf course, the project represents a rare convergence of lifestyle excellence and long-term investment value.
Currently approximately 10% complete, Luštica Bay is progressing according to a comprehensive master plan designed to accommodate over 6,000 residents upon full completion.
The finished development will comprise more than 3,000 apartments, over 300 luxury sea-view villas, and seven hotels, anchored by a Gary Player Signature 18-hole golf course.

Infrastructure expansion includes a second marina with on-site Port of Entry and fuelling facilities, increasing total berth capacity to 220 and further enhancing the destination’s regional and international accessibility.

With a total investment value of approximately €1.5 billion, Luštica Bay represents one of the largest real estate developments in South-Eastern Europe and the largest greenfield investment in Montenegro.

Sustainability and environmental stewardship are central to the project’s design: of the 690-hectare site, only 10% is allocated to built neighbourhoods, preserving the majority of the landscape as protected green areas with indigenous flora.

The community offers a highly differentiated lifestyle ecosystem, combining pristine beaches, swimming pools, sports and wellness facilities, hiking and cycling trails, a championship golf course, and vibrant public spaces featuring local markets and cultural experiences.

This holistic approach has translated into strong financial performance, with historical average annual property appreciation of approximately 13%, and further upside anticipated as key infrastructure—most notably the golf course—reaches completion.
Luštica Bay offers highly competitive investment terms, including 0% property transfer tax, interest-free payment plans of up to five years, and immediate rental income potential upon handover.

Expert Aldar The Source Terraces Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi The Source Terraces by Aldar is a highly anticipated collection of luxury apartments situated on the prestigious Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, developed by Aldar Properties.
This development promises to offer an exclusive lifestyle with a range of modern amenities and services designed to cater to the high standards of its residents.
The starting price of apartments for sale at The Source Terraces is 3 000 000 AED (about 816 800 $).
Potential investors and homeowners can expect luxury apartments that showcase modern design, premium amenities, and services.
These include a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, sauna, steam room, yoga and meditation rooms, rooftop zen gardens, and terraces, as well as cycling tracks.
The handover date of property at Aldar The Source Terraces is Q3 2027, while the payment plan is 60/40 with a 10% down payment.
Saadiyat Island, the location of property at The Source Terraces, is a renowned cultural and residential hub in Abu Dhabi, offering a mix of natural beauty, cultural richness, and modern luxury.
The island is celebrated for its 9 km of natural beachfront, luxurious waterfront resorts, and an award-winning golf course.
It's also known for hosting the Middle East’s leading beach destination, with accolades to its name every year since 2012.
Residents and visitors can enjoy a wide range of dining options, from exclusive fine dining in the island's resorts to a variety of standalone dining concepts catering to all tastes.
The island is easily accessible, located just 500 metres off the coast of Abu Dhabi and about 20 minutes away from Abu Dhabi International Airport.

Residents of apartments on Saadiyat Island offers a variety of transportation options, including special shuttles, taxis, private cars, and public transport, ensuring seamless connectivity to the rest of the UAE.
The climate on Saadiyat Island is typical of the UAE, with hot summers and cool winters, making it a year-round destination.
The best time to visit is from October to April when the weather is cooler, providing an ideal climate for enjoying the outdoors, including cafes, terraces, beaches, and promenades.

Investing in property on Saadiyat Island, particularly at developments like apartments at The Source Terraces by Aldar, holds significant appeal due to the island's economic growth, lifestyle offerings, and investment potential.

With its strategic location, commitment to cultural development, and an array of amenities and attractions, Saadiyat Island offers a compelling destination for homeowners and investors alike, looking to buy property in Abu Dhabi.

Is Janu Residences a good investment?
Yes, Janu Residences is a strong investment due to its prime waterfront location on Al Marjan Island and high-quality design.
The development offers modern residences with spacious layouts, large windows, energy-efficient smart home features, and premium materials, ensuring long-term comfort and enduring appeal.

Who is the owner of Janu Residences?
The owner and developer of Janu Residences is Amana Development, a real estate company focused on premium waterfront communities in Ras Al Khaimah.
Amana Development oversees the planning, design, and delivery of the project, ensuring high-quality construction, modern interiors, and sustainable features.

Janu Residences is a freehold development, granting buyers full ownership of their properties and land.

Shopping is another advantage: big malls like Mall of Antalya, Agora, and IKEA are all just a short drive away.
Altıntaş is in constant progress—new parks, more infrastructure, and new facilities, which increase property values as well.
Unlike tourist-heavy areas, this part of Antalya is meant for real, year-ound living.
For families, professionals, and international homeowners looking for a fresh, well-connected place to settle, luxury apartments in Altıntaş are one of the most appealing options in Antalya.
Location of The Complex The complex offers a peaceful residential atmosphere while remaining close to the city’s main attractions.

The location benefits from the area's rapidly developing infrastructure, and excellent connectivity to Antalya Airport, the city center, Lara’s vibrant dining and leisure scene, and the Mediterranean coastline.

Leading the Way in Sustainable Living: OXO The Residences Sold Out in 1 Day Skip to content BOOK YOUR STAY BOOK YOUR STAY June 18, 2024 Business, Featured, The Residences Leading the Way in Sustainable Living: OXO The Residences Sold Out in 1 Day OXO Living set a new benchmark in sustainable real estate with the sell-out of all 40 units at OXO The Residences Nyanyi-Bali within one day of its launch.

In an extraordinary achievement, OXO Living has set a new benchmark in sustainable real estate with the rapid sell-out of all 40 units at OXO The Residences Nyanyi-Bali within just one day of its grand launch on June 8th, 2024.
This remarkable feat not only highlights the demand for our luxury villas but also showcases our commitment to sustainability, making us a leader in green real estate development in Southeast Asia.
A Testament to Sustainable Excellence At OXO, sustainability is a core principle that guides our development and management practices.
OXO The Residences exemplifies our dedication to creating environmentally friendly yet luxurious living spaces.
Our villas are designed with cutting-edge green building principles, including solar panels, rainwater harvesting systems and advanced water treatment facilities.
These features ensure that our properties not only reduce environmental impact but also provide significant cost savings for owners through lower energy and water consumption.
High Demand and High Returns The swift sell-out of our 40 luxury villas, ranging from 3 to 5 bedrooms, demonstrates the market’s strong preference for sustainable living.
Investors and homebuyers alike recognize the value of our properties, not just for their aesthetic and functional appeal but also for their high return on investment (ROI).

With prices ranging from Rp 8 billion to Rp 16 billion per unit, these villas offer premium living experiences complemented by OXO Living’s exceptional property management services, ensuring consistent value appreciation.
Leading the Way in Green Real Estate OXO The Residences is celebrated as the most sustainable real estate project in Southeast Asia.
Following our commitment to green building standards, this project will be certified by the Green Building Council Indonesia (GBCI).
We are also actively pursuing international B Corp certification, affirming our dedication to integrating sustainability into every aspect of our projects, from construction to daily operations.
Overcoming Challenges for a Greener Future Achieving such high standards of sustainability hasn’t been without its challenges.
The initial financial outlay for sustainable technologies and materials is substantial.
However, we believe that these investments are crucial for long-term environmental and economic benefits.
Additionally, staying ahead of technological advancements requires continuous adaptation and learning.
Educating and ensuring that our team, partners and clients understand and embrace these practices has also been an ongoing effort.
Yet, these challenges have only strengthened our fundamental principle to lead by example in the real estate industry.

The Future of Sustainable Luxury Living In summary, our success with OXO The Residences is a clear indicator of a broader shift in consumer preferences and it is evident that the future of luxury real estate lies in sustainability.
As we continue to develop beautiful, eco-forward properties, as always we will strive to enhance the quality of life for our buyers whilst contributing positively to the environment.

The scheme comprises three one-bedroom and two two-bedroom residences built in a traditional Moroccan riad style, with red-stone detailing, arched motifs and indoor-outdoor living spaces.
It sits a short distance from Kuta's main restaurant street while remaining set back for privacy, placing residents close to dining, surf beaches and the wider amenities of the south coast.
The villas are sold off-plan, with construction underway and handover targeted for the second half of 2027.
One-bedroom units start from approximately USD 75,200and two-bedroom units from approximately USD 158,000, converted from the developer's AUD pricing — confirm at the live exchange rate.

Buyers can acquire through a personal leasehold or a freehold-equivalent HGB structure held in a dedicated PT PMA foreign-investment company, a recognised legal pathway for foreign ownership in Indonesia that offers a longer-horizon position than the leasehold-only model common in Bali.
The development provides communal amenities and an optional rental-management programme for owners who wish to let their villa when not in residence.

TerraKuta lies within the Mandalika Special Economic Zone, a government-prioritised tourism district anchored by the Pertamina Mandalika circuit and served by Lombok International Airport roughly 25 minutes away.
The zone has drawn sustained infrastructure and hospitality investment, and Kuta's dining and surf scene continues to mature, supporting both end-use and rental demand.
The project's five-unit count and managed-rental option suit lifestyle owners and investors seeking a design-led villa in a growth corridor rather than a large estate.
Prospective buyers should independently verify per-unit floor areas, the leasehold term, the amenity specification and rental-programme terms with the developer before committing capital.

Viewz 2 By Danube in context Researched & verified editorial — updated 3 Jul 2026 Comparing the twins: Viewz 1 and Viewz 2 Danube markets Viewz as a single project, but it is legally and physically two towers — Viewz 1 and Viewz 2 — built to the same specification on opposite sides of an internal street within Jumeirah Lake Towers, connected by shared sky bridges.

Listings distinguish them informally as a west-facing tower and an east-facing tower, but Danube has not published a documented difference in unit mix, finish level, or amenity allocation between the two; both draw from the same studio-to-five-bedroom sky-villa range and the same Aston Martin interior collaboration.

Absent a verified spec difference, the more useful framing for a buyer is that Viewz 1 and Viewz 2 are functionally identical products competing for the same tenant and resale pool — which means unit-level factors like floor level, lake sightline, and distance from the shared podium will matter more to pricing than which tower the unit sits in.

The payment structure Viewz carries Danube's standard 1%-monthly payment model: a booking deposit followed by a construction-linked schedule, with the balance paid in 1% monthly instalments that continue through and beyond handover rather than concluding at key collection.

This spreads a meaningful share of the purchase price into the post-handover period, which lowers the upfront capital a buyer needs relative to a conventional 50/50 or 60/40 plan, but it also means the developer is carrying buyer receivables well past June 2026 completion.

That is a financing structure decision on Danube's part, not a discount, and it should be weighed against the fact that the two towers deliver at effectively the same time — so the post-handover instalment book across both buildings lands simultaneously.
What a two-tower, single-date handover does to the rental pool The detail that matters most for anyone leasing rather than flipping is timing concentration.

With both towers expected to complete together rather than in staggered phases, roughly 1,128 apartments enter the JLT leasing market in the same window instead of trickling in over successive quarters.

That is a materially different dynamic from a single-tower handover: landlords across both buildings will be competing to lease up at the same time, in the same cluster, against comparable stock — which tends to soften asking rents in the first two to three quarters after handover before the pool absorbs into JLT's broader tenant base.
JLT's underlying demand, anchored by DMCC's free-zone workforce, has historically supported high lease-renewal rates, which should help absorption once the initial wave clears.

But an owner planning to lease within the first two quarters after handover should expect more competing supply in the immediate vicinity than a single-tower project of comparable size would produce, and price accordingly rather than assume day-one asking rents will hold.

Practical read for buyers of either tower Because the two towers are effectively interchangeable on paper, a buyer choosing between a Viewz 1 or Viewz 2 unit is better served comparing floor, view line and price per square foot than chasing a tower-level distinction that current disclosures do not support.

The bigger variable to underwrite is the shared handover date itself — 1,128 units landing on the JLT rental market together is the factor most likely to affect near-term yield, more so than which side of the street the unit sits on.

Bahia Papagayo - Costa Rica's Newest Beach Development Skip to content Bahia Papagayo Juntos desde la raíz Real Estate Costa Rica Team FAQ’s Press Downloads Bahia Papagayo Juntos desde la raíz Real Estate Costa Rica Team FAQ’s Press Downloads INQUIRE Welcome to Pura Vida…Perfected Unparalleled natural beauty, rich local culture, and an endless spirit of freedom has long made Costa Rica the pinnacle of the life well lived.
Now, on the most prestigious piece of coastline, in the most desirable region of the country, Bahia Papagayo offers an enticing residential lifestyle to make all your own.

Bahia Papagayo More Than an Escape…A Way of Life Only 20 minutes from Guanacaste International Airport (LIR), on the stunning shores of Costa Rica’s North Pacific region, surrounded by the highly-sought-after beaches of the Gulf of Papagayo and hundreds of acres of original dry forest, a visionary destination is taking shape.

It is a first-of-its-kind residential destination with its own town-center atmosphere and resort-level amenities, complete with collections of single-family homes, condos, and villas across multiple charming neighborhoods and seamlessly connected to dozens of activities, delights, adventures, special moments, and shared experiences.
This is Bahía Papagayo.

Brought to life by industry leaders in real estate and hospitality, each with 50+ years of experience directly in Costa Rica, Enjoy Group and Grupo Laguna are shaping the future of exclusive luxury living while still maintaining the authentic wonder of this special place.

Learn More Meet the team Explore Bahía Papagayo Offerings There are only a few places left in the world where the stunning beauty of the location and a profound sense of serenity make someone feel like they are living life exactly where they belong.
Bahía Papagayo is one of them.

SERENO RESERVE EL MANGROOVE RESIDENCES MUSEO CONDOS MAREA CONDOS SERENO RESERVE MANGROOVE RESIDENCES MUSEO CONDOS SEASIDE CONDOS Community Offerings A Delightfully Different Paradise At more than 320 acres and 1.5 miles of beachfront, Bahía Papagayo is a beachtown designed for discerning tastes.

While it’s close to some of the most prestigious branded resorts in the country, the mood here is more authentic, more in touch with the real Costa Rica, and more focused on the enjoyment of everyday experiences done exceptionally well.

Only 30% of the total property will ever be developed, ensuring that the natural beauty of the landscape remains intact for generations, and that residents and guests continue to feel the calm and relaxation of leaving the rest of the world outside.

Even within Bahía Papagayo, great care and consideration have been taken to create residential experiences that are flexible in terms of rental potential and strong resale value so that your home with us is rewarding to own in every way possible.

Learn More Community Offerings Explore Our Residences Marea Condos Museo Condos Sereno Reserve El Mangroove Solea Papagayo Costa Rica A Paradise Within Paradise Part of what makes Bahía Papagayo so special, even within Costa Rica, is its one-of-a-kind location.

It is set within the Polo Turístico Golfo de Papagayo (Gulf of Papagayo Tourism Project) in the Guanacaste Province, a designated tourism area that is also home to much of Costa Rica’s cultural and natural heritage.

Protected ecosystems and eco-friendly enjoyment go hand-in-hand here, with gorgeous coral reefs for snorkeling and diving, stunning Pacific waters for sailing and boating, lush nearby dry and rainforests to explore by trail or zipline, waterfalls, volcanoes, and some of the most diverse and beautiful flora and wildlife on earth.
Best of all - it’s only 20 minutes from Guanacaste International Airport (LIR) and a few hours drive from Juan Santamaría International Airport (SJO).
vIEW dESTINATION Development Team Visionary Developers It takes extensive first-hand knowledge and expertise to bring a project like Bahía Papagayo to Costa Rica.
There must be a profound respect for the land, the natural setting, and the people with a desire to preserve these precious elements for the future.
The team behind Bahía Papagayo fits this criteria perfectly, with two of the most respected and successful companies in Costa Rica working together to execute this exciting vision.
Grupo Laguna brings more than 50 years of direct hands-on experience in developing master planned communities throughout the country.
Enjoy Group, a family-owned business also has the benefit of 50+ years experience, but in the hospitality realm.
Together, they deliver the insight necessary for making this first-of-its-kind lifestyle destination a reality.

Everything You're Wondering Questions, answered How close is Crystal Garden to the golf course and to the beach?
+ The Las Iguanas fairways start at the property line — Crystal Garden's two buildings sit directly on the course, and every residence faces it.

Two beaches are open to residents: Playa Caracol is roughly 1,800 ft away, about a ten-minute walk, while Juanillo Beach , Cap Cana's signature white-sand stretch, is about 2.4 miles — some eight minutes by car.
The Cap Cana Marina sits between them at about 2.6 miles by road, and Punta Cana International Airport is around 20 minutes away.
Can a foreign buyer own a residence at Crystal Garden outright?
+ Yes.

The Dominican Republic places no restriction on foreign ownership of real estate: a non-resident buyer takes the same freehold title as a Dominican national, in their own name or through a company, with no residency requirement.
Purchases are transacted in US dollars and title is recorded with the national Title Registry.
When is Crystal Garden due to be finished?
+ Delivery is scheduled for August 2027 .
Construction is already under way, and the developer publishes dated work-progress photography for the project.
What layouts and sizes does Crystal Garden offer?
+ 196 residences across two mid-rise buildings — one, two and three-bedroom apartments plus two-level penthouses with a family room and private terrace.

Published interiors run from about 920 sq ft for a two-bedroom to about 1,360 sq ft for a three-bedroom before terraces; many homes add covered and uncovered terrace space, and ground-floor residences add a private garden.

The sizes shown on each floor-plan card are TOTAL constructed area — interior plus terraces — so a three-bedroom listed here at about 1,360 sq ft of interior appears on its plan card at roughly 2,250 sq ft total.
Does Crystal Garden qualify for CONFOTUR, and what does that exemption cover?

Under the Dominican tourism-investment law known as CONFOTUR, a qualifying residence is exempt from the 3% property-transfer tax on purchase and from annual property tax (IPI) for 15 years from delivery.
The exemption attaches to the property, so it carries through the years you hold it.
Can I use the residence myself and still put it in the rental program?
Crystal Garden operates as a condo-hotel and the managed rental program is optional.
Owners block the dates they want for their own stays and release the rest to the program, which handles bookings, guest services and housekeeping through the developer's rental-management arm.
Who designed Crystal Garden, and who is building it?
+ Crystal Garden is developed by Gesproin Group , a Dominican developer active in Punta Cana and Cap Cana; it is the seventeenth project in its portfolio.
The architecture is by MORPH , a Spanish studio whose work won the OPAL 2021 award for architectural design.
What happens after I register?
+ You receive the full package — floor plans, the current price list and live availability — and an advisor who knows this specific building rather than a call centre.
There is no cost and no obligation, and if you would like to see Cap Cana in person we will help arrange the visit.
