Add a feedback Information about the project Comfort by Orbi is set in one of Batumi’s best-developed districts, offering a perfect blend of modern features and prime location.
It’s an appealing choice for anyone looking to live by the sea while staying close to all the energy and convenience of city life.

Highlights of the complex prestigious property; vibrant, well-established neighborhood; close to the promenade and beaches; panoramic sea views; excellent transport connections; cutting-edge technologies and quality materials; thoughtfully designed floor plans; high ceilings; panoramic windows and large balconies; barrier-free access; quiet, high-capacity elevators; 24/7 video surveillance system; landscaped courtyard with greenery; spacious parking; multi-level outdoor lighting; on-site infrastructure; flexible purchase options; ideal for living or investment; experienced developer.
Location Comfort by Orbi is located at 21a Pirosmani Street in the Khimshiashvili area, known for its strong infrastructure and well-organized transport network.
The position within the block means you can easily navigate the city and enjoy all the local advantages without being overwhelmed by heavy traffic.
Being close to the coast means more chances to enjoy the beach, and many apartments look out over the shoreline and resort, adding something special to everyday life.
A major road is just 180 meters away — close enough for quick access, but far enough to keep things quiet inside the complex.
This smart layout means the area stays dynamic without feeling overloaded.
Another bonus is Ardagani Lake Park nearby, perfect for walking, outdoor workouts, or just relaxing in nature.
The green spaces add to the feel of the neighborhood and help keep the local climate pleasant.
The architecture of Comfort by Orbi fits seamlessly into its surroundings.
Panoramic windows face key directions, opening up beautiful views and letting in more natural light.
The buildings integrate smoothly with nearby structures without clashing.
Here, you get function, easy access to recreation, and less street noise all in one place.
It makes Comfort by Orbi a natural fit in the overall plan of the district and shows smart urban design.
Transport A public transport stop is just 245 meters from the complex.
From there, you have: buses No.
7, 12, 16, 19, 77, and the Batumi–Shuakhevi route; and minibuses No.
They run about every 12 minutes, so it’s easy to plan your trips around Batumi without relying on a car.
The seaport is three kilometers away, with pleasant walks along the piers.
It’s also where you’ll find the Argo cable car, which offers breathtaking views of the coastline and foothills from its observation deck.
The old bus station is a 20-minute walk and serves routes to nearby towns and the wider region.
Five kilometers away is the Metro bus terminal for both domestic and international travel.
Batumi-Passenger railway station is around six kilometers away, while the international airport is only ten.
Having all these transport hubs close by means you can always choose the best option for your needs and schedule.
The transport setup around Comfort by Orbi is carefully thought out — every key hub is nearby, saving time and keeping life running smoothly.
Local infrastructure The neighborhood around Comfort by Orbi is designed for everyday convenience.
You’ll find everything close by: from small minimarkets to large stores with wide selections.
There’s no shortage of cafés, pizza places, and restaurants either, so grabbing a meal or spending an evening out is always easy.
The nearby streets also give you quick access to essential services.
Private clinics, dental offices, banks, and pharmacies are all within walking distance, cutting down on travel time for routine tasks.
The area is built around a smart, multi-use core where stores and services complement each other, making daily life straightforward.
There are plenty of leisure options too.
Within about 1.5 kilometers you’ll find attractions like a dolphinarium, aquarium, small zoo, and seasonal cultural spaces, including an open-air cinema.
These spots often become regular stops where work life shifts into family time, adding to the area’s overall appeal.
For more serious shopping, Batumi Plaza is just three kilometers away.
It’s a large shopping and entertainment center with stores, boutiques, places to eat, and entertainment zones — a great alternative to daily grocery runs and a chance to expand your choices.
Getting to administrative and legal services is just as easy.
A few blocks away you’ll find tax offices, territorial administration, and the House of Justice.
That makes handling official matters faster and saves trips across town.
Grocery shopping is also simple with big-name chains like Carrefour, Goodwill, and Nikora close by.
Their broad selections let you pick up food and household supplies all in one place — perfect if you like staying organized and planning ahead.
Cultural landmarks add another layer of interest.
Local icons like the distinctive fountain, “White Magnolia,” and Luzhnikov House give the neighborhood a strong identity.
These spots are well-known to locals and often included in tourist guides, adding visual charm to the area.
Sports are covered too.
A modern stadium that meets international standards is just a 10–15-minute walk away.
It hosts not only games but also concerts and public events, making it an important part of the area’s social life.
Altogether, this neighborhood is a smart mix of everything — from shopping to culture, daily services to major event spaces.
It works just as well for an active lifestyle as it does for more relaxed daily living.
The wide variety of nearby places creates a dependable foundation for handling errands, enjoying your free time, and staying organized day to day.
Features of the development The concept behind Comfort by Orbi combines bold vertical scale with sleek, modern design.
This 34-story tower stands out on the city skyline, creating a striking image where smart engineering meets strong visual appeal.
Its height speaks to the project’s forward-looking ambition, while the façade raises the architectural standards of the entire area.
Balanced proportions both vertically and horizontally ensure the building blends seamlessly into the surrounding urban landscape.
The tower’s design shows off technical precision, emphasizing thoughtful scale and structural confidence.
This isn’t architecture that tries to copy trends — it has its own character: calm, exact, and rhythmic.
The façade mixes glass, concrete, and clean lines with a strong vertical emphasis.
Panoramic windows strengthen the connection between indoor spaces and the outside scenery, highlighting views and elevating the everyday visual experience.
Construction uses a proven monolithic frame method, guaranteeing structural integrity, long-term durability, and flexibility for interior layouts.
With a building this tall, special attention goes into engineering — robust components and joints are built to perform reliably for decades.
That means a stable load-bearing system, minimal deformation, and high resistance to the elements.
All essential utilities are fully integrated.
Electricity, water supply, and drainage systems connect to the city grid and meet strict technical standards.
Everything works together under a unified concept of sustainable, efficient operation.
Ventilation and fire safety systems are built into the main structure, making them easier to maintain and more reliable.
Passenger elevators are a standout feature.
The building is equipped with quiet, high-speed models designed for heavy use in high-rises.
Each section has enough elevators to handle busy periods without long waits.
Entry points are equipped with intercom systems for secure access throughout.
Shared areas carry the same refined aesthetic as the building’s exterior.
Lobbies, hallways, and common spaces all follow a cohesive design with neutral tones and durable materials.
Wear-resistant finishes and quality details keep these spaces looking good for years with minimal maintenance.
Accessibility was a top priority.
Entryways and exits are designed for all users, including people with limited mobility and parents with strollers.
This shows the technical maturity of the project and its ability to adapt to daily life.
Entrances have convenient ramps, and elevators are easily accessible from ground level.
Comfort by Orbi is a prime example of how engineering solutions can work seamlessly with architectural expression and practical needs.
It’s a large-scale approach to residential living, focused on reliability, functionality, and visual harmony.
Everything — from floor plans to the finishing of shared spaces — works together as a coordinated system that’s built to handle the pace of city life and meet the expectations of demanding residents.
Landscaping and everyday amenities Comfort by Orbi pays attention not only to construction quality but also to how people live day to day.
Engineering and organizational solutions are designed to take routine burdens off residents so they can focus on what matters.
The entire property is under 24/7 monitoring, with cameras covering the perimeter and inside the building to create a secure environment.
A professional security team complements this system to keep everything running smoothly.
The outdoor area is laid out for multiple uses.
Walkways follow a logical, easy-to-navigate layout, with resting spots in between — benches, shaded areas, and pockets of greenery.
Landscaping combines trees, shrubs, and neat flower beds to improve the visual feel and help stabilize the microclimate, easing the summer heat and reducing wind.
Commercial spaces on the lower floors blend seamlessly into the overall concept.
Shops, cafés, salons, and a pharmacy are all on-site, saving residents time on daily errands and cutting out extra trips across the city.
For families, there are play areas with safe surfaces and equipment for different ages.
These playgrounds are fenced and monitored, giving parents peace of mind while kids play.
Lighting is carefully planned throughout the complex.
Energy-efficient fixtures are positioned to keep the entire area well-lit without dark spots.
Both main paths and quiet seating areas have soft lighting that avoids glare and creates a sense of safety and comfort at night.
It’s not just decorative — it’s a precise technical system integrated into the overall site management.
Parking is handled with an underground garage exclusively for residents.
Keeping cars below ground avoids cluttering the courtyard, cuts noise, and makes the area safer for pedestrians.
Visitors have designated spots above ground near the entrance, so they don’t disrupt the flow of resident traffic.
Comfort by Orbi takes a technically smart approach to building residential infrastructure.
Nothing here is random — every choice is tied to what people actually need.
Landscaping, engineering systems, community spaces, and security all work together to balance functionality with clean, attractive design.
This isn’t a complex built just for show — it’s built for real convenience.
Everything is organized for a wide range of residents, from young professionals to families.

By combining a solid technical base with thoughtful security, greenery, lighting, and internal logistics, it offers more than just a living space — it’s a well-orchestrated system for those who value order, practicality, and attention to detail.
Apartment sales Comfort by Orbi offers a wide selection of apartments designed to suit different lifestyles and household sizes.
You’ll find everything from compact studios perfect for singles, to spacious three-room layouts ideal for families or those who simply want more room to breathe.
The tower itself includes around 580 apartments, which speaks to the scale of the project and the diversity of options available.
Large balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows are a direct response to the growing desire for open views and a closer connection to the outdoors.
This design approach makes each apartment feel more expansive, letting you enjoy privacy while still feeling linked to the world outside.
The units are delivered in a "black frame" finish — a technical shell that gives you total creative freedom to tailor your interior exactly how you want it.
High ceilings further expand the sense of space, allowing light to spread evenly and naturally.
Thanks to this, even the more compact apartments feel open and airy, without the limitations of traditional layouts.
Apartments can be purchased through a straightforward full payment.
To explore other buying options — such as possible installment plans or financing — you can visit the sales office, where consultations are tailored individually.
The address is available on the official website.
Overall, Comfort by Orbi is a well-balanced, carefully planned development with robust engineering and a variety of floor plans.
Functionality and aesthetics come together here to create comfortable, stylish spaces — equally appealing for living or investing.
The complex smartly blends urban convenience with natural surroundings, adding a distinctive new highlight to Batumi’s cityscape.
About the developer For more than twenty years, ORBI GROUP has been steadily building its reputation in the construction industry, becoming one of the leading developers in the region.
Their consistent, thoughtful approach at every stage — along with meticulous attention to business processes — has helped maintain a strong reputation even in a highly competitive market.
Over the years, they’ve created an impressive portfolio where each project stands out with its own character and high standards of quality.
Their achievements are regularly recognized by professional awards that reflect real success, not just appearances.
Behind this track record is strict quality control and a well-organized internal structure that can quickly adapt to market shifts and evolving customer needs.
ORBI’s strategy is about more than completing individual projects; it’s focused on building long-term relationships, putting reputation and follow-through first.
Over time, their operations have extended well beyond Georgia.
Today, ORBI GROUP is present in dozens of countries, opening direct channels to international clients.
This gives them a clear edge: questions are resolved fast, without middlemen or unnecessary bureaucracy.
It shortens the distance between company and client, making communication smoother and more efficient.
Potential buyers interested in investing in seaside property can see ORBI’s projects firsthand in Batumi.
Site visits allow you to judge the construction pace, quality, and technical details up close — so you form your own impression without relying on marketing materials or secondhand accounts.
ORBI GROUP doesn’t just rely on past success.
They continue launching new initiatives, expanding international partnerships, and integrating advanced technologies.
For them, architecture is more than a checkbox — it’s a competitive strength.
Their willingness to explore unconventional ideas results in projects that capture attention from industry experts and buyers alike.
Consistent performance, large-scale operations, and a structured company strategy all provide a solid base for future growth.
Here, development isn’t about chasing volume — it’s about steady progress with a clear long-term vision.
ORBI GROUP remains one of the developers truly shaping the market, setting not just the pace, but the standard — and that standard keeps moving upward.

Recommend Location Show on map Country Montenegro Region Budva Municipality Village Becici About the complex A brand-new, modern residential building in the popular resort town of Bečići.
The building is located on the Adriatic Highway, just a 10-minute drive from the center of Budva.
Nearby, you’ll find a supermarket and seafood restaurants.
This is the fifth building in a new development by the same developer, with the previous four buildings already completed and occupied.
The sandy beach is only 200 meters away via a flat road.
The building consists of six floors and 39 apartments with one to three bedrooms.
Nearly all apartments offer stunning views of the sea and Bečići Beach.
The units are sold with high-quality finishing and built-in plumbing.
The complex features an elevator and parking spaces.
All apartments boast high-quality finishes and an air conditioning system for both cooling and heating.
Cable TV, telephone, and internet connections are available.

The developer offers an installment payment plan linked to construction phases, which is one of the most common payment methods for purchasing new apartments in Montenegro: • 35% initial payment upon signing the contract • 20%, 15%, 15%, and 10% every six months • 5% upon completion of construction.
The estimated completion date is 2027.
About Bečići.
Bečići is a charming seaside resort town known for its stunning beach.
A pedestrian tunnel connects the Bečići promenade to Budva, offering a scenic route for walking and cycling all the way to Budva’s Old Town.
In the opposite direction, the promenade stretches to the village of Kamenovo, featuring beautiful beaches, restaurants, and cafés with breathtaking views.
The town is home to well-known hotels such as Splendid, which boasts a luxurious SPA center and a Japanese restaurant, and Mediteran, which features its own water park.

Golf Dale by Emaar · Emaar South, Dubai · JRE Dubai Projects Areas Developers Guides Insights Videos Global Advisory EN AED Agent login Home / UAE / Dubai / Golf Dale On sale Emaar Golf Dale Emaar South , Dubai From AED 2,701,888 Handover Q4 2028 Enquire Brochure Overview Gallery Residences Payment Amenities Location Documents FAQ The Project From AED 2,701,888 Status On sale Handover Q4 2028 Size 1,399–2,559 sqft Residences 4 Construction 0% complete Furnishing Kitchen only Service charge 15 AED/sqft Golf Dale is a residential development by Emaar, situated within the master-planned Emaar South community in the south-western corridor of Dubai.
The project comprises two- and three-bedroom apartments across a single building, with handover scheduled for December 2028.

# The building and its place in Emaar South Emaar South occupies a deliberate position between Al Maktoum International Airport and the former Expo 2020 site, a stretch of Dubai that the city's planners have been quietly reorienting around for the better part of a decade.
Golf Dale sits within this community, organised around an 18-hole championship golf course that defines the neighbourhood's spatial character as much as its leisure offer.
The district reads as low-density by Dubai standards.
Tree-lined streets and open landscaping are structural to the masterplan rather than decorative afterthoughts.
For buyers accustomed to the compressed towers of Downtown or Business Bay, the scale here is a deliberate contrast.

# Residences, layouts and specification The available units run from two-bedroom apartments at approximately 1,399 square feet, priced from AED 2,701,888, to three-bedroom configurations spanning 2,542 to 2,559 square feet, with pricing between AED 4,543,888 and AED 4,717,888.
That size range is generous for the apartment category, particularly at the three-bedroom level, where layouts approach the footprint of a modest townhouse.
Kitchens are fitted as standard.
Beyond that, interiors are delivered unfurnished, which suits buyers intending to appoint the space to their own specification rather than inherit a developer's furniture package.
Service charges are set at AED 15 per square foot annually, a figure worth factoring into holding-cost calculations before purchase.
# Amenities anchored to the golf course setting The facility list reflects the community's outdoor orientation.
Residents have access to the 18-hole championship golf course and its clubhouse, adult and children's swimming pools, an outdoor gym, a jogging track, and a yoga deck.
There is no indoor fitness centre listed among the confirmed amenities.
Buyers for whom a dedicated gym is essential should verify current specifications directly before committing.

# Connections to the wider city Al Maktoum International Airport sits roughly 7.4 kilometres away, a proximity that matters considerably for frequent travellers and for long-term capital value, given the airport's expansion trajectory.
The beach at XO Beach is approximately 25.8 kilometres distant, and City Centre Me'aisem, the nearest major retail destination, is around 33.6 kilometres by road.
South View School Dubai is approximately 29 kilometres away.
The distances underline something buyers should factor honestly: Emaar South functions best for those who are comfortable with car dependency or who work near the southern corridor.
It is not a walk-to-everything address.
# Who this suits and where it sits in the market Golf Dale occupies an entry point into Emaar-branded freehold property that remains accessible by Dubai luxury standards.

The two-bedroom price point below AED 2.8 million, combined with the developer's track record and the airport proximity, makes it a credible option for buyers prioritising capital growth over immediate urban convenience.

The profile fits a particular kind of purchaser: a golf-oriented household, a professional with frequent international travel, or an investor taking a view on the southern Dubai corridor ahead of Al Maktoum's continued expansion.
It is not an address for someone whose social life depends on proximity to the city's established dining and cultural centres.
For those whose priorities align with what Emaar South actually offers, the value proposition is coherent.

One to three bedroom freehold apartments from a guide of QAR 2,000,000, with completion scheduled for Q4 2027.
Les Vagues by Elie Saab is Dar Global's first address in Qatar and the first residential development in the country with interiors by Elie Saab.
It stands on the marina promenade of Qetaifan Island North, the leisure island at the northern edge of Lusail, and every residence sits on the first line to the water.

The name is French for "the waves", and the design follows it: clean, contemporary lines softened by palms and tropical planting, with terraces and floor-to-ceiling glass turned to the sea, the marina and the Lusail skyline.
Dar Global launched sales in October 2022 alongside Qetaifan Projects, the island's master developer, which is owned by Katara Hospitality.
The scheme is larger than its quiet street presence suggests.
Dar Global's results for 2025 describe five towers holding 424 apartments and retail units, with one, two and three bedroom homes.
Apartments run from about 81 sqm for the smallest one bedroom to about 257 sqm for the largest three bedroom.
Guide prices start from QAR 2,000,000, about US$549,000, and launch pricing reached around QAR 6 million for the largest homes.
Each apartment is priced by size, floor and outlook, so the number that matters is the one attached to the home you choose.
Construction began in December 2023, and Dar Global now schedules completion for the fourth quarter of 2027.

That makes Les Vagues an advanced off-plan purchase rather than an early one: the building is well under way, but the contractual completion date and the terms that apply if it moves still need checking.

Qetaifan Island North lies within Lusail, one of Qatar's ten freehold areas, so international buyers hold title in their own name, and every home here clears the QAR 730,000 threshold that supports a renewable residence permit.
Omnia advises the buyer.

We'll compare the towers, floors and layouts that fit your brief, request current availability and exact prices, and explain the payment schedule that applies to the remaining homes before you reserve.
Floor plans are shared on request.

Dar Global has two further addresses on the same island: L'Horizon by Elie Saab, a building of two bedroom apartments scheduled for the end of 2027, and Sea La Vie, one bedroom plus den apartments from QAR 1,874,950 with completion anticipated in June 2030.
On a visit we can show you all three side by side.

Qatar's first Elie Saab address Les Vagues brought Elie Saab's residential design to Qatar for the first time.

The couturier's team designed the interiors of the apartments, and pieces from the Elie Saab Maison furniture collection furnish the lobbies and shared spaces, so the same hand runs from the front door to the terrace.

The architecture takes its cue from the sea around the island: clean, contemporary lines, softened by palms and tropical planting, with balconies, terraces and floor-to-ceiling windows that open each home to the water.
At launch, Qatar became the third city for Elie Saab residences after London and Dubai.
Five towers on the marina promenade Les Vagues is made up of five towers on the marina promenade of Qetaifan Island North.
Dar Global's results for 2025 give 424 apartments and retail units across the five, with shops at street level and homes above.
Every residence is first line to the water, so the outlook from the apartments is to the marina, the open sea and the Lusail skyline across the channel rather than to a neighbouring building.
Ask us which tower and floor an available apartment sits in, because the outlook and the light change noticeably along the promenade.
The apartments Homes are one, two and three bedroom apartments.

As a guide, one bedroom homes run from about 81 to 126 sqm, two bedroom homes from about 124 to 137 sqm and three bedroom homes from about 177 to 257 sqm, with the larger plans carrying the widest terraces.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the water in the living rooms and main bedrooms.

Amenities for residents Residents share an infinity swimming pool, a fitness centre and a landscaped community courtyard with sea views.
A 24-hour reception desk and an a la carte concierge service handle the practical side of daily life, and every apartment comes with parking.
Luxury retail at the foot of the towers adds everyday convenience.
Because the island itself supplies the beach clubs, the waterpark and the restaurants, the buildings concentrate on the essentials and do them well.
Life on Qetaifan Island North Qetaifan Island North covers about 1.3 million sqm off the northern edge of Lusail and is designed around leisure.
Meryal Waterpark has 36 rides, and its Rig 1938 tower is recognised by Guinness World Records as the tallest water slide tower in the world.
Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North and its Azure Beach club, waterfront souqs and a retail plaza sit within a few minutes of Les Vagues.
Across the bridge, Lusail Boulevard is about five minutes by car, Katara Cultural Village and The Pearl-Qatar about twelve, West Bay about fifteen and Hamad International Airport about thirty.

As a guide, one bedroom homes run from about 81 to 126 sqm, two bedroom homes about 124 to 137 sqm and three bedroom homes about 177 to 257 sqm.
How many homes are there?
+ Dar Global's results for 2025 describe five towers holding 424 apartments and retail units.
Every residence is first line to the marina.
When will Les Vagues be completed?
+ Construction began in December 2023, and Dar Global schedules completion for the fourth quarter of 2027.
As with any off-plan purchase, confirm the contractual completion date and its terms in your sale documents.
What is the payment plan?
+ The plan offered since launch has been 20% on reservation, 70% during construction and 10% on handover.
With construction well advanced, the schedule for remaining homes may differ, so we confirm it on your chosen apartment.
Can foreigners buy at Les Vagues, and is it freehold?
+ Yes.
Qetaifan Island North lies within Lusail, one of Qatar's ten freehold areas, so international buyers can hold freehold title in their own name with no time limit.
We confirm the current rules and your eligibility before you commit.
Does buying at Les Vagues support residency in Qatar?
+ A purchase of at least QAR 730,000 supports a renewable residence permit, and every home here is above that level.
10 of 2018, subject to conditions.
What fees and taxes apply?
+ The Ministry of Justice transfer fee is 0.25% of the price, about QAR 5,000 at the guide price.
We'll add any developer fees and the estimated service charge to a full cost breakdown.
What amenities does Les Vagues have?

+ An infinity swimming pool, a fitness centre, a landscaped community courtyard with sea views, a 24-hour reception desk, a la carte concierge services, parking for every apartment, and luxury retail at the towers.
How far is Les Vagues from Doha and the airport?

+ By car, about five minutes to Lusail Boulevard, ten to Lusail Stadium, twelve to Katara Cultural Village and The Pearl-Qatar, fifteen to West Bay and about thirty to Hamad International Airport, depending on traffic.
How does Les Vagues compare with L'Horizon and Sea La Vie?
+ All three are Dar Global addresses on Qetaifan Island North.
Les Vagues offers one to three bedroom homes and is the furthest advanced.
L'Horizon by Elie Saab is a building of two bedroom apartments scheduled for the end of 2027, and Sea La Vie offers one bedroom plus den apartments from QAR 1,874,950, completing in June 2030.
Can I see floor plans and arrange a viewing?
Send us your budget and preferred size and we'll share floor plans, current availability and prices, then arrange a visit to Qetaifan Island North.

It is a small district in its own right, with Grade-A offices, a shopping and dining street, a landscaped centre called The Grand Park and a members' Vitality Club.
The homes are arranged around all of it.
They come in two collections.
Executive Residences are apartments of one, two and three bedrooms, 70 m² to 147 m².
Park Residences are townhouses of three and four bedrooms plus apartments of two, three and four, from 90 m² up to 332 m².
Both are handed over fully furnished.
Floors are 60x60 European porcelain, sanitaryware is Kohler, Duravit or Roca, kitchen countertops are engineered stone, and the lighting is concealed LED on European branded switches.
Both collections share one payment plan, and it is front-loaded.

You pay 20% on signing, 10% when the basement structure is done, 20% at the third-floor slab, 20% at the sixth-floor slab, 20% at the façade, 10% at finishing, and the last 5% on title transfer or handover with the real estate transaction tax included.
That puts 95% of the price behind you before you get the keys and leaves nothing owing afterwards.
Money is held in escrow at Alinma Bank.
The service charge is SAR 75 per m², which excludes the members' club.
DarGlobal sells to individuals of any nationality with 100% foreign ownership.

The developer DarGlobal London-listed luxury developer, building Padel Living and Amaya in Jeddah DarGlobal PLC is an international luxury real-estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange , and it is the international arm of Saudi Arabia's Dar Al Arkan Group.

It trades on the LSE Main Market under the ticker DAR and builds with partners including the Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott, Missoni, Pagani and Versace .

Jeddah is where its Saudi work is concentrated: Trump Plaza Jeddah and Trump Tower Jeddah are both under development in the city, and Palmera represents two further schemes, Padel Living Residences and Amaya .

2017 Founded Dubai, United Arab Emirates Headquarters View DarGlobal About Jeddah Saudi Arabia's Red Sea gateway, with 57 approved ownership zones Jeddah is Saudi Arabia's second city and its Red Sea port , and it has always been the country's most outward-facing place.
Pilgrims have arrived here on their way to Makkah and Madinah for centuries, and it was a trading city long before anyone called it a tourist one.
That history is why it reads differently from Riyadh.
Riyadh runs on government and on the companies moving their regional headquarters there.
Jeddah runs on the coast, the events calendar and a resident population that has lived alongside foreigners for generations.
Two numbers matter to a non-Saudi buyer.
The first is 57 , the count of approved zones in Jeddah where foreign ownership is permitted under the law in force since 22 January 2026, Jeddah Central among them.
That is the widest access of any Saudi city.
The second is price: apartments here average around SAR 4,385 per m² , well under what the same space costs in the capital.

Each home faces the Le Rempart and La Tourelle peaks and blends tropical Mauritian architecture with the volumes of a French country house: a 67 m² living room beneath 6 m vaulted ceilings, three en-suite bedrooms, a mezzanine fitted as a fourth bedroom, a back kitchen, a laundry, a double garage, a 14.5 m rim-flow pool and a thatched kiosk.
Developer price list of September 2026 (received 2 October 2026) : villas 1, 2 and 3 sold.
Phase 1: Villa 4, 2,173.93 m² plot, released upon completion, delivery February/March 2027, price on request.
Phase 2, 18-month construction: Villa 5, 2,103.20 m² plot, at €1,850,000; Villa 6, 1,847.05 m² plot, at €1,750,000.
Each offers 304.7 m² covered, 218.5 m² external, 620.2 m² in total and a 71.4 m² pool; optional independent garden studio at €90,000.
Villa 7, a 4,163.25 m² double plot, the largest in the estate, with an existing house to be renovated: details and price on request.

In every home: an individual 10,000-litre underground water tank, PV-ready wiring with an 18 kVA hybrid option, an individual sewage treatment plant with irrigation tank, a rainwater harvesting option, a fully fitted Arrital Italian kitchen, Italian wardrobes and sanitary ware, air conditioning in the bedrooms, optical fibre and a 6 kVA generator.
Prices subject to change, excluding notary fees, government taxes, soft furnishings and decoration packs; areas rounded; plans and images indicative and non-contractual.
An approved PDS (Property Development Scheme) development, open to foreign buyers, developed by Property Lab (Belouget Investments Ltd) with NK Architect, completion guarantee from MauBank.

Maisons de Bonneval occupies a property of about four acres within the Domaine de Belouguet, reached via Black Rock Road.

The developer's brochure describes an African-looking savannah where deer, hare and boar once roamed, now a private neighbourhood of three adjoining residential domains with strict building guidelines that keep density low.

Tamarin is minutes away: the bay and its surf beach, the C-Care and Life Together clinics, the Paul & Virginie and West Coast international schools, Middlesex University, the Super U and Cascavelle shopping centres, London Way, La Place Cap Tamarin, the Riverland sports club and the beaches of Tamarin and Flic en Flac.
The hike to the summit of La Tourelle starts at the end of the road.
Project overview Seven homes on large plots, under 20% footprint A human-scale project: seven freehold family villas, each facing the mountains and laid out so that none looks onto another.

The NK Architect master plan sets the seven lots on either side of a private road: villas 1 to 4 to the west, villas 5 and 6 to the east, and villa 7's double plot at the centre with its existing house and mature trees.
The building footprint stays below 20% of the land, leaving each home a large tropical garden, two visitor bays and planted driveways.
The estate gives access to a greenhouse for growing vegetables and to a freshwater borehole for irrigation, optional for each villa.
Security is provided by the Domaine de Belouguet: self-closing gates, access cards and digital code.
Villas 1, 2 and 3 are sold; villa 4 will be released upon completion in February/March 2027; villas 5 and 6 are built in eighteen months; villa 7 is presented on request.

Project overview The home: a 67 m² living room under 6 m ceilings, three suites and a mezzanine An open single-storey plan extended by a mezzanine, a back kitchen and a double garage, around a 71.4 m² rim-flow pool.

The NK Architect schedule of areas (lots 36 and 37) details 304.7 m² covered: a 67.2 m² living-dining-kitchen, a 23.9 m² master bedroom with a 12.7 m² walk-in wardrobe and a 9.4 m² en-suite, bedrooms 2 and 3 of 15.2 and 16.3 m² each with wardrobe and shower room, a 20 m² mezzanine with bathroom, walk-in wardrobe and balcony, a 14.5 m² back kitchen, an 8.7 m² laundry, a 7.6 m² store and a 48.6 m² double garage with storage.
Outside, 218.5 m²: a 59.3 m² veranda, a 19.4 m² thatched kiosk, a 16.9 m² barbecue area, a 71.4 m² pool including overflow, 27.4 m² of tiled decking, a drying yard and a courtyard.
The other areas (entrance pergola, 35.8 m² internal courtyard, buried pump room, outdoor shower) bring the total to 620.2 m².
The optional garden studio adds a 19.7 m² bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchenette and a veranda, 39 m² in all.
Project overview Italian finishes and options Finishes sourced from European suppliers, personalised with the developer, and a list of options to go further.

The September 2025 Buyers Specifications provide for a fully fitted Arrital Italian kitchen with quartzite worktops and AEG or Bosch appliances (oven, microwave, American-style fridge, dishwasher, five-burner hob), Italian sanitary ware and tapware, Italian built-in wardrobes with walk-in closets in the master bedrooms, porcelain tiles of at least 900 × 900 mm, charcoal aluminium joinery certified for cyclonic loads, air conditioning in the bedrooms, ceiling fans, optical fibre and an individual 6 kVA generator.
Each home has a buried 10,000-litre potable water tank, an individual sewage treatment plant and an irrigation tank.

Options: independent garden studio at €90,000 for villas 5 and 6, pool extension to 20 m, 18 kVA hybrid photovoltaic installation, rainwater harvesting, boma and barbecue area, roller shutters on the outdoor living areas, wooden flooring in the master bedroom, planting of an orchard.
The homes face the mountains and enjoy the sunset over Tamarin Bay.

Project overview Buying at Maisons de Bonneval: PDS, guarantees and timeline An approved PDS development, therefore open to foreign buyers as freehold, with building permit, completion guarantee and a precise delivery timeline.

Maisons de Bonneval is approved under the Property Development Scheme (Investment Promotion Regulations 2015), with a PDS certificate received on 3 September 2025, a building permit from the Black River District Council and a completion guarantee approved by MauBank.
Contractual areas are expressed as net internal area, as required by Mauritian notarial practice.
Prices on the September 2026 list exclude notary fees, government taxes, soft furnishings and decoration packs, and remain subject to change.
Villas 5 and 6: eighteen-month construction from reservation.
Villa 4: delivery February/March 2027.

GADAIT International reconfirms availability with the developer before every presentation and organises the visit of the estate; turnkey rental management by HORIZON Properties is offered to owners as an option.
Maisons de Bonneval: the key answers What buyers ask before reserving a home at the Domaine de Belouguet.
Where is Maisons de Bonneval located?
In the Domaine de Belouguet in Tamarin, on the west coast of Mauritius, at the foot of La Tourelle mountain and five minutes from the beach.
Access via Black Rock Road.
How much does a home cost?
On the developer's September 2026 price list: €1,750,000 for villa 6 and €1,850,000 for villa 5, excluding notary fees and taxes, with an optional garden studio at €90,000.
Villa 4, released upon completion, and villa 7, a double plot with a house to renovate, are offered on request.
Which homes are still available?
Villas 1, 2 and 3 are sold.
Villa 4 (on completion, February/March 2027), villas 5 and 6 (phase 2) and the double plot of villa 7 remain.
Availability is reconfirmed with the developer before every presentation.
What are the areas?
Villas 5 and 6: 304.7 m² covered, 218.5 m² external, 620.2 m² in total, 71.4 m² pool, on plots of 2,103.20 and 1,847.05 m².
Villa 4: 2,173.93 m² plot.
Villa 7: 4,163.25 m² double plot.
When will the homes be delivered?
Villa 4: February/March 2027.
Villas 5 and 6: construction announced in eighteen months from reservation.
Can a foreign buyer purchase?
Yes.
The development is approved under the Property Development Scheme (2015 regulations), a scheme that opens freehold ownership to non-citizens.
The PDS certificate was received on 3 September 2025.

FOUR SEASONS NEVIS PEAK RESIDENCES CELEBRATE | Four Seasons Resort Estates Nevis | Caribbean Real Estate on Nevis FOUR SEASONS NEVIS PEAK RESIDENCES CELEBRATE • Latest News • 30 April 2025 OFFICIAL GROUNDBREAKING EVENT Back to Nevis News Online Premier Brantley, Developers, Sotheby’s & Four Seasons executives, Archdeacon Phillip join in marking the occasion Tuesday, April 8, 2025, Charlestown, Nevis—On a bright blue-sky April Tuesday, the exclusive Four Seasons Nevis Peak Residences formally and officially broke ground on the next and possibly last major expansion of the resort’s private residences.
The long-awaited event was begun with welcoming by Sotheby’s International Realty St.

Kitts & Nevis CEO Neil Paine and a prayer by Archdeacon Phillip then continued with remarks by Premier Mark Brantley, by developers David Chekemian and Richard Maltz of The Integrum Group and by Four Seasons Resort Nevis General Manager Billy Cueto.
With the silver, engraved shovels tossing the first shovel-fulls of earth, a cheer went up and Neil Paine announced the official groundbreaking complete.
The new Four Seasons Nevis Peak Residences are planned to offer 52 one, two, three and four bedroom residences including penthouses spanning four buildings.
Each residence will offer exceptional views of the Caribbean Sea, the Robert Trent Jones II golf course and/or the dramatic Nevis Peak.

The new community will include a residents swimming pool, clubhouse and access to all of the five-star perks of Four Seasons Nevis such as golf, full service spa and fitness center, four on-site restaurants, tennis and pickleball courts, the Kids for All Seasons program and 24/7 concierge and housekeeping services.
With interiors by London based, award winning Ward & Co and architecture design by the award winning St.
Kitts Brisbane O’Garro Alvaranga group, and exceptional landscape design all around, these casual condominium units seamlessly blend contemporary design with Nevisian ease and influences.
The residences begin at $1.4 million.
Ownership of these residences offers the opportunity to participate in the popular St.
Kitts & Nevis Citizenship by Investment program, noted as the longest-lived program of its kind in the Caribbean.
For more information, contact fourseasons@stkittsnevissir.com or +1.869.662.3388.

本物件の販売を行うLIRタイオフィスは2018年に高級不動産仲介ブランド「サザビーズ インターナショナル リアルティ®」 のタイ国内独占営業権を取得しオフィスを開設以降、世界80以上の国と地域に広がるネットワークを強みにタイ国内のみならず海外においても富裕層向け高級不動産売買の取引を行ってきました。また、2026年春にはバンコク中心部のランドマークビルであるゲイソン・アマリン・タワーへ移転しクロスボーダー取引を加速させています。「サザビーズ インターナショナル リアルティ®」の持つ世界規模の富裕層顧客のネットワークやタイ国内での高級不動産の販売実績が評価され、この度、本物件を日本で初めて取り扱うことになりました。
■物件の特長 1.

アジア太平洋地域初のSLS Residences SLSは、世界各国でホテル、レジデンス、レストラン、ナイトライフを展開するライフスタイル・ホスピタリティブランドです。遊び心もありつつラグジュアリーで非日常感を演出するデザイン、社交性の高い空間づくりを特徴としています。現在、SLSブランドのレジデンスは、ドバイ、マイアミ、カンクン、ブエノスアイレスなど世界各地で展開されており、本物件はアジア太平洋地域初のSLSブランドレジデンスとなります。
バンコク中心部・Sukhumvit 24という特に日本人に人気の高い立地 バンコクの中でも高級住宅地として人気の高いスクンビット24通りに位置しています。本物件の最寄り駅であるBTS「プロンポン」駅には駅直結で大型商業施設が2つあり、日本人に馴染みのある飲食店や物販店が多く入っており生活利便性が高いことから日本人が多く住んでいるエリアです。
全78戸の限定性とプライバシー性のある配置計画 36階建、全78戸で1フロアに1～4邸の計画のため、バンコクの中心地にありながらプライバシー性に配慮された設計です。また、バンコク中心部の高層マンションは総戸数が多い物件が多い中、本物件は全78戸と限定的であるという希少性が特長です。
Accor Ownership Benefits Programの対象予定 入居者はAccor Ownership Benefits Programの対象となる予定であり、アコーホテルズの会員プログラムにおいて最高ランクのダイヤモンドステータスの獲得や、オーナー様専用VIP予約デスクなどグローバルでのVVIPステータスや各種特典を受けることができます。

■LIRタイオフィス ジェネラルマネージャー 武居浩平 コメント 「近年のバンコクでは、世界的なホテルブランドやライフスタイルブランドが手がけるブランデッドレジデンスへの注目が急速に高まっています。その中でも、SLS Residences Bangkok Sukhumvit 24は、アジア太平洋地域初のSLS Residencesとして、バンコクの高級住宅市場に新しい価値観をもたらすプロジェクトになると考えております。特に、バンコクの中心居住エリアであるSukhumvit、なかでもプロンポン・トンロー方面において、世界的なホテル・ライフスタイルブランドを冠したレジデンスは極めて限られており、本物件は立地・ブランド・戸数のいずれにおいても非常に希少性の高いプロジェクトです。SLSは、従来型のラグジュアリーにとどまらず、デザイン、食、社交性、体験価値を融合させたライフスタイルブランドです。Sukhumvit 24というバンコク中心部の希少な立地において、全78戸という限定性を備えた本物件は、日本のお客様にとっても、居住用・投資用の双方で非常に魅力的な選択肢になると考えております。リスト サザビーズ インターナショナル リアルティは、世界各国のネットワークとタイ現地での高級不動産販売実績を活かし、今後も日本のお客様に対して、真に価値ある海外不動産をご提案してまいります。」 ■物件概要 物件名 SLS Residences Bangkok Sukhumvit 24 所在地 Sukhumvit Soi 24, Khlong Tan Subdistrict, Khlong Toei District, Bangkok 10110, Thailand 交通 BTS「Phrom Phong（プロンポン）」駅徒歩10分 売主 Elysian Park Co., Ltd.

The Residences at Mandarin Oriental Da Nang — Apartment in Da Nang by The Nam Khang Corporation · Da Nang, Da Nang, Vietnam Q2 2026 Completion 43 floors Floors 2 Buildings 988 units Total Units 172000 sqm Project Size RUMAVI Expert Analysis Independent assessment by the RUMAVI editorial team Investment Highlights The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, Da Nang targets the premium and ultra-luxury segment in a market where branded-residence supply is limited.
Da Nang's beachfront corridor in Ngu Hanh Son has seen luxury product pricing reach USD 3,000–5,500 per sqm, and the Mandarin Oriental brand commands a significant premium over unbranded competitors.
The Phase 1 villa component is priced at approximately USD 4,500–5,000 per sqm of built area.
For a project of this scale, the apartment towers (988 units) represent the volume product, but apartment pricing has not been publicly disclosed as of early 2026.
The two-year 6% guaranteed rental yield provides a known income floor, though buyers should note that MOHG operates under a licensing arrangement that can be terminated.
Developer Nam Khang was established in 2007 with a focused Da Nang luxury portfolio.
Foreign buyers receive leasehold only; Vietnamese buyers can access full freehold, creating a two-tier ownership market.

limited track record for high-rise apartment delivery at this scale Completion Q2 2026 — project is in construction; execution risk remains Foreign buyers receive leasehold only; Vietnamese buyers can access full freehold — creates a two-tier ownership market Recommended For Ultra-high-net-worth buyers seeking a trophy branded residence in Central Vietnam Investors targeting the upper end of the Da Nang holiday rental market via a global luxury brand Golf and heritage tourism enthusiasts seeking a permanent or vacation base near major attractions Long-term capital preservation investors in a globally recognised branded asset class Not Recommended For Buyers requiring price transparency before committing (prices not disclosed publicly) Mid-market investors (entry pricing is above most Vietnam property investment budgets) Foreign buyers seeking freehold title (leasehold only for non-Vietnamese) Short-term liquidity seekers (ultra-luxury market in Da Nang is thin for rapid resale) Risk Assessment Brand License Termination Risk Medium Developer Delivery Risk Medium Pricing Opacity Risk High Supply Concentration Risk Low Overview The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, Da Nang is a branded luxury real estate development situated in Hoa Hai Ward, Ngu Hanh Son District, on a 17.3-hectare beachfront site with direct access to the Da Nang coastline.
The project is developed by The Nam Khang Corporation and managed under a brand licensing agreement with Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group.
The development includes two 43-floor apartment towers offering 988 residential units, plus 128 resort villas — including 60 residential land villas offered for sale.
Interior design for the residences was completed by Yabu Pushelberg, a prestigious New York-based studio known for luxury hospitality projects globally.

The development's location is served by proximity to three UNESCO World Heritage Sites — Hoi An Old Town, My Son Sanctuary, and Hue's Imperial City — as well as five international-standard golf courses within a 30-minute radius.
The project's landscape architecture integrates streams, cascading water features, and garden pathways within the natural beachfront setting.

Residents have access to the full Mandarin Oriental hotel service stack, including five dining and bar outlets, Mandarin Oriental Spa with signature treatments, water sports facilities, and a curated wellness program.
From an investment perspective, the project targets ultra-high-net-worth buyers and is priced at the premium end of the Da Nang market.
A rental management program with a guaranteed minimum income of 6% per annum for two years from handover has been referenced by the developer for villa investors.
The apartment towers (988 units) represent the higher-volume element of the project and are expected to be released to the market as the project progresses toward its Q2 2026 completion date.
The development is subject to completion risk as it remains under construction.

What types of properties are available at Mira Ocean Estates?

A sculpted façade with flowing curves and warm metallic accents rises above the sea, while every level is oriented towards open water and the city skyline.

The collection spans studios and flexible studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, King's layouts with signature dressing areas, and a separate wing of Ocean Residences with larger suites set closer to the water.
Read more Read less Residents enjoy an extensive programme of amenities spread across a lifestyle deck, a wellness deck and a sky deck.
The podium brings together a children's water park, a dancing fountain, padel, basketball and cricket courts, cabanas, a sensory garden and barbecue areas.

A wellness floor features an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym and a longevity lounge with cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, red light therapy and a salt room, while indoor spaces include a private cinema, a podcast studio, a business centre, a dance studio, a golf simulator and a kids' play area, crowned by a rooftop clubhouse and outdoor deck.
All residences are delivered fully furnished, with floor-to-ceiling glazing that frames uninterrupted sea views.

Thoughtful planning adds convertible layouts, multipurpose rooms, dual-access bathrooms and dedicated laundry areas in selected homes, while King's units include generous wardrobe and dressing suites finished in refined, light-toned materials.
Location description and benefits Dubai Maritime City is a waterfront district on a man-made peninsula between Port Rashid and the historic heart of Bur Dubai.
The district is shaped as a lifestyle destination by the sea, close to Port Rashid, the Dubai Cruise Terminal, Dubai World Trade Centre and Jumeirah Beach.
The peninsula connects quickly to Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, while Dubai International Airport and Palm Jumeirah remain within easy reach.

The community plan includes a planned metro station, a proposed shopping mall, a beach, a sunset promenade, a sports park, a cable car, a sky walk bridge and a mosque, adding everyday convenience along the water.
Waterfront living close to the main business and tourism hubs of Dubai continues to attract professionals, families and holiday renters.
Dubai Maritime City combines this appeal with its central coastal position and growing community infrastructure, supporting steady demand for both long-term rentals and premium short-stay homes.

Wasl 1, Al Kifaf, Dubai Launch price from AED 4,400,000 Available now from AED 4,498,000 Handover April 2030 (Tentative) 0% Buyer Commission About Nine Collective at Wasl 1, Al Kifaf, Dubai Nine Collective by Wasl is a freehold residential tower in Wasl 1, the developer's parkside master community in Al Kifaf, central Dubai.

Rising to 3B+G+44 floors beside Zabeel Park, it brings together 215 residences - 2, 3 and 4 bedroom homes, 3 and 4 bedroom duplexes and 5 bedroom duplex penthouses - and the developer's fact sheet confirms a maid's room in every residence.
Wasl 1 sits where central Dubai's business districts meet the open green of Zabeel Park.
The park and the Dubai Frame lie alongside, while the Sheikh Zayed Road corridor, Dubai World Trade Centre, Downtown Dubai and DIFC are a short drive away.
Nine Collective is positioned as a cosmopolitan address for families, professionals and buyers who want generous space and landscaped surroundings without leaving the city centre.
The architecture is built around nine geometric modules that shift and evolve as the tower rises, giving Nine Collective a sculpted silhouette rather than a single monolithic block.
Stone-inspired surfaces and solid volumes are balanced with expansive glazing, layered balconies add depth across the facade, and integrated planting softens the form.
At ground level the building opens onto a central plaza that ties it into the surrounding streetscape and skyline.

Interiors follow a contemporary, restrained palette - neutral tones, stone-inspired surfaces and warm wood, with refined bathroom finishes and open living and dining spaces framed by large windows that lead out to balconies.
The developer's fact sheet specifies modular fitted kitchens with integrated appliances, including a cooker, dishwasher, fridge and washing/drying machine.
Materials and finishes shown in the brochure are illustrative; the sale agreement governs the final specification.

The residence mix published in the developer's fact sheet: 110 two-bedroom residences of 1,946 to 2,163 sqft, 54 three-bedroom residences of 3,086 to 3,121 sqft and 41 four-bedroom residences of 4,071 to 4,287 sqft.
The duplex collection comprises 3 three-bedroom duplexes of 4,212 to 4,288 sqft and 3 four-bedroom duplexes of 5,507 to 5,718 sqft, crowned by 4 five-bedroom duplex penthouses of 8,115 to 8,253 sqft.
These are published ranges, not current availability, and layouts vary by residence - floor plans are indicative and subject to change.

Amenities at Nine Collective cover wellness, leisure and family life: a 25m outdoor swimming pool, a sky infinity pool, an adult lounge and pool, a rooftop lounge, an indoor gym and outdoor fitness deck, spa, sauna and treatment rooms, and an indoor padel court.

Families have a family hub, multipurpose family room, children's play zones and a private cinema room, while a multipurpose event hall, private dining spaces, BBQ stations and a residents' library lounge serve social life.
Retail and F&B outlets, EV charging, dedicated bicycle storage, 24/7 concierge and a driver's lodge for select premium residences complete the offer.

The developer's brochure places Dubai World Trade Centre about 5 minutes away, Downtown Dubai and DIFC about 10 minutes, and Dubai International Airport about 15 minutes - indicative times that vary with traffic and route.
The brochure's location map also marks World Trade Centre and Emirates Towers metro stations on the Sheikh Zayed Road corridor.

The property is a fully legal and registered 30-year leasehold.
Ownership can be held under your personal name or a company, giving you full usage rights and priority to extend the lease upon expiry.
What happens after the leasehold end?
You retain first priority to renew your lease for an additional 25 years.
The renewal price will be determined at fair market value, validated by independent appraisals from trusted local agents.
Is it mandatory to use Blacksand Management?
It’s not mandatory to use Blacksand Management, but highly recommended.
Our in-house team ensures a consistent guest experience, optimized occupancy, and seamless maintenance from day one.
When I will get the keys?
Construction for the new Blacksand Villas has already begun.
As this is an off-plan project, you can expect handover and keys by January 2027, following completion and full inspection by our team.
Can I stay in the villa myself?
Yes.
You’re free to stay in your villa whenever you wish.
Just let our team know, and we’ll reserve the dates for you to ensure a seamless, private stay.
Are foreigners eligible for loan or financing?
Local banks in Indonesia currently do not offer financing to foreign buyers.
However, we’ve had clients successfully secure business loans or financing through their own banks overseas.
While we don’t have formal partnerships with any lender, this can be a practical option depending on your home country’s banking policies.
What's the process to reserve a unit?
Message us on WhatsApp or visit our Interactive Price List to check current availability.
To secure your villa, you’ll place a 10% holding deposit into a notary-managed escrow account during a two-week legal due diligence period.
Upon signing, a 30% payment is made and the villa is legally transferred into your name.
The remaining balance follows the agreed construction progress schedule.

Nee, buitenlanders kunnen geen grond bezitten op Bali.
Hak Milik (vrije eigendom) is alleen voor Indonesische burgers.
Buitenlandse kopers gebruiken meestal erfpacht of Hak Pakai (gebruiksrecht) voor residentiële doeleinden.
Bij ZAYARI raden we het volgende aan erfpacht in combinatie met Hak Pakai omdat het betaalbaarder is, rechtszekerheid biedt en je alle rechten geeft die je nodig hebt zonder onnodige complexiteit.

Samenvatting: Vrije grond = alleen Indonesiërs Erfpacht + Hak Pakai = aanbevolen, veilig & kosteneffectief PT PMA (bedrijf) is niet perse nodig tenzij je het bedrijf zelf wilt runnen Welke due diligence wordt er gedaan op het land?

We controleren eigendomstitels, bestemmingsplannen en vergunningen voordat we land leasen We voeren due diligence uit om de rechten van de landeigenaar te bevestigen, bestemmingsplannen voor toeristisch/residentieel gebruik te controleren en bouw-/exploitatievergunningen te verifiëren.
Dit voorkomt verrassingen en zorgt voor naleving.
We raden klanten altijd aan om ook hun eigen due diligence uit te voeren.
Samenvatting: Titel controleren (eigendom, lasten) Controleer bestemming (toerisme/residentieel) Vergunningen bevestigen (bouw/operationeel) Kan leasehold worden verlengd of vernieuwd?
Ja, indien onderhandeld en notarieel bekrachtigd.
Een lease overeenkomst wordt niet automatisch verlengd.
Verlengingen moeten worden geregeld met de landeigenaar en worden vastgelegd door een notaris.
Bij ZAYARI onderhandelen we waar mogelijk vooraf over duidelijke verlengingsvoorwaarden, zodat je rechten voorspelbaar zijn.
Samenvatting: Geen automatische verlenging Uitbreidingen per contract + notaris ZAYARI voert de onderhandelingen voor jou Kan ik mijn leasecontract tijdens de looptijd doorverkopen of overdragen?
Ja, als het contract overdracht toestaat.
Een lease overeenkomst kan worden verkocht of overgedragen aan een nieuwe koper voor de resterende looptijd, zolang de overeenkomst dit toestaat.
Wij zorgen ervoor dat je leaseovereenkomst overdraagbaar is, zodat je flexibiliteit behoudt.

Samenvatting: Overdracht mogelijk met toestemming landeigenaar + notaris Koper neemt resterende jaren over ZAYARI zorgt ervoor dat leases overdraagbaar zijn Kan ik een villa financieren met een hypotheek of bieden jullie betalingsregelingen?
Lokale hypotheken voor buitenlanders zijn zeldzaam; in plaats daarvan bieden we gestructureerde betalingsplannen aan.
Indonesische banken verstrekken over het algemeen geen leningen aan buitenlandse particulieren.
Bij ZAYARI volgen kopers een gefaseerd betalingsplan gekoppeld aan mijlpalen in de bouw, waardoor het voorspelbaar en veilig is.

Het is ook mogelijk om een financiëring te krijgen wanneer er overwaarde is op vastgoed in Nederland Samenvatting: Hypotheken voor buitenlanders = zeer beperkt Fase betalingen = standaard aanpak Gekoppeld aan bouwmijlpalen, niet alleen vooraf Wat voor rendement kan ik realistisch gezien verwachten?
Rendementen zijn afhankelijk van bezetting, dagprijzen en kosten.
12-20% netto is wat ons betreft realistisch.
Bali villa’s kunnen goed presteren als ze professioneel worden beheerd.
Met een goede bezettingsgraad en marktconforme prijzen zien veel investeerders nettorendementen van 12-20%.
Wij rekenen voor onze projecten met 14% om schattingen aan de conservatieve kant te laten zien.
Wie beheert mijn villa als ik er niet ben?
Wij werken samen met House of Reservations , een erkende touroperator met jarenlange ervaring.
Zij zorgen voor alles, van marketing tot gastenservice, schoonmaak, personeel en naleving van de belastingwetgeving.
Op deze manier wordt je villa volledig beheerd, zelfs als je in het buitenland woont.
Natuurlijk ben je vrij om elk managementbedrijf te kiezen (of geen), maar we raden dit ten zeerste aan om een hoge ROI te bereiken.
Samenvatting: Professionele gediplomeerde operator Full-service beheer (van boekingen tot schoonmaak) Hands-off voor investeerders Moet ik fysiek in Bali aanwezig om te kunnen investeren?
Nee, alles kan op afstand worden geregeld.
Ook al raden we een bezoek aan en willen we je graag ontmoeten: Met een volmacht en digitale ondertekening hoef je niet op Bali te zijn.
We sturen updates via foto’s en video zodat je altijd op de hoogte bent.

Amenities Swimming Pool Fitness Centre Parking Co-working lounge 24/7 security Private garden Kids Area Lobby Rooftop terrace Restaurant Concierge Lounge Sauna Spa & wellness BBQ Area Fully furnished It is The Standard’s residential expression in Hua Hin following the brand’s local hotel presence, combining residential ownership with service culture, design identity and selected brand-linked privileges.

The core proposition is quite different from a conventional resort condo: this is a branded residence targeting buyers who value hospitality DNA, design curation and a more globally recognisable lifestyle signal.
The project covers a land area of 9-0-78.6 rai, with 251 total units across a low-rise composition of one 7-storey building, seven 4-storey buildings and four 1-storey buildings.

The unit mix runs from one-bedroom residences at 40.75 to 65.25 sq.m., to two-bedroom residences at 77.00 to 119.25 sq.m., three-bedroom residences at 107.00 to 153.00 sq.m., and beachfront pool villas at 215.75 to 238.75 sq.m.

This is materially larger and more premium than standard Hua Hin condominium stock, and the room mix itself indicates that the project is designed for real living, family use and higher-end second-home ownership rather than only weekend micro-unit demand.
The facilities are extensive and unusually lifestyle-driven even by branded-residence standards.
They include the lobby, four swimming pools, gym, pickleball, bowling alley, spa room, experience shower, salt sauna, mud lounge, pavilion, BBQ pit, lawn, hideaway and pet zone.
The project is built around seaside leisure, social hosting and a more playful interpretation of Hua Hin’s heritage.

Resident privileges include brand-linked benefits such as room discounts at The Standard hotels globally, food and beverage and spa discounts at The Standard hotels in Thailand, and invitations or preferential rates for events and ticketed experiences.
That privilege layer is not the whole investment case, but it does matter because branded projects often derive part of their marketability from ecosystem identity rather than just floorplan logic.

From a neighbourhood and positioning standpoint, The Standard Residences Hua Hin sits in Hua Hin’s high-quality coastal leisure setting, leaning into the town’s long-standing identity as a refined seaside escape.
For international buyers from Europe, the UK and India, the project is best understood as a branded Thai residential lifestyle asset rather than a conventional mass-market condominium.
It belongs to the category where hospitality affiliation, design, service orientation and owner-use quality are central to the product’s value.

Nasim Al Bahr Residences is located in Ras Al Khaimah, on Al Marjan Island, directly along the Arabian Gulf coastline.
Is Nasim Al Bahr Residences Freehold or leasehold?
Nasim Al Bahr Residences is a freehold development, allowing buyers full property ownership rights without time restrictions or lease limitations.
What is the Payment Plan of Nasim Al Bahr Residences ?

Nasim Al Bahr Residences – Payment Plan Nasim Al Bahr Residences offers two structured payment plan options: Option 1 10% Down Payment – Paid at sales launch 20% During Construction 70% On Handover Option 2 10% Down Payment – Paid at sales launch 30% During Construction 60% On Handover Both options begin with a 10% down payment, with the remaining balance divided between the construction phase and the final payment at handover.
Is Nasim Al Bahr Residences a good investment?
Yes, Nasim Al Bahr Residences is a strong investment opportunity , supported by location, design quality, and hospitality-backed management.
The project is located on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah , a beachfront destination with 5.4 kilometers of white sandy beaches and direct Arabian Gulf views.
The island continues to attract tourism, luxury hospitality brands, and premium residential developments, supporting property value growth and rental demand.
Nasim Al Bahr stands out through its twin-tower architecture , full sea views, and direct beach access.
The residences feature natural stone finishes, timber tones, floor-to-ceiling glass façades, open-plan layouts, and fully equipped kitchens.
These specifications meet the expectations of both end-users and high-income tenants.
The development includes fine dining venues, a private pool, spa facilities, indoor padel courts, a gym, kids’ areas, games rooms, screening rooms, and concierge services .
Backed by Abu Dhabi National Hotels, the project benefits from established hospitality expertise, which supports operational standards and brand credibility.
Beachfront supply on Al Marjan Island is limited.
Properties with hotel-level services and direct sea access hold stronger resale potential and short-term rental appeal.
For buyers seeking capital appreciation, rental income, or long-term asset value in a growing coastal market, Nasim Al Bahr Residences presents a competitive option.
What is Nasim Al Bahr Residences's starting price?
Nasim Al Bahr Residences starts from AED 3,500,000.
This starting price applies to the entry-level units within the development.
Prices vary depending on unit type, size, layout, and view.
Who is the owner of Nasim Al Bahr Residences?
Nasim Al Bahr Residences is owned and developed by Abu Dhabi National Hotels (ADNH) .
The company is a publicly listed hospitality and real estate group with a portfolio that includes hotels, resorts, and property assets across the UAE.
ADNH brings operational experience in hotel management and property development, supporting structured delivery standards and long-term asset management for the project.
When is Nasim Al Bahr Residences's Delivery date?
Nasim Al Bahr Residences is scheduled for delivery on 1 January 2028 .
The handover date marks the completion of construction and the official transfer of units to buyers.
Upon delivery, owners will receive access to their residences along with the project’s full range of amenities and beachfront facilities.
What are the housing options of Nasim Al Bahr Residences?
Nasim Al Bahr Residences offers a selection of apartments, townhouses, and villas with defined sizes and starting prices.
Apartments include one- to four-bedroom layouts.
1-bedroom apartments start from AED 3.5 million , with sizes ranging from 976 to 1,414 sq ft .

The villa collection offers larger standalone homes.
2-bedroom villas start from AED 22 million , with a size of 5,504 sq ft .
3-bedroom villas range from 3,070 to 11,697 sq ft .
This range of unit types allows buyers to choose between waterfront apartments, spacious townhouses, or large private villas on Al Marjan Island.

residential tower by Ayala Land Premier, anchoring the new Dela Rosa Gardens mixed-use district within Makati’s Central Business District.

Breaking ground in February 2026 after achieving about USD 174.6 million in pre-sales — more than one-third of its approximately USD 470 million total project value — Laurean will house 388 exclusive units with only 8 to 9 residences per floor, with turnover targeted for Q3 2032.

The development sits at the strategic intersection of Dela Rosa Street and Paseo de Roxas, connected by elevated walkways to Greenbelt, Glorietta, and the MRT Ayala Station, placing residents at the centre of the country’s leading financial district with convenient pedestrian access to offices, shopping, and transport.

Unit configurations include suites from 75 sqm at approximately USD 679,800, two-bedroom residences from 133 sqm, three-bedroom units up to 253 sqm, and four-bedroom bi-level villas of 402 sqm reaching up to USD 5.03 million.

Three-bedroom and larger homes include bathtubs, built-in refrigerators, and wine chillers, while all residences are finished to a high standard with European kitchen appliances, smart toilets, and premium engineered flooring.
Ceiling heights reach up to 3.2 metres, and floor-to-ceiling windows capture wide views of the Makati skyline and Laguna de Bay.

Amenities span more than 5,000 sqm across three dedicated levels, including leisure spaces on Level 10, meditation and sky gardens on Level 60, and a wellness and social club on Levels 66 and 67 with a gym, spa, private cinema, wine lounge, and co-working areas designed for modern luxury living.
From an investment perspective, Laurean Residences commands around USD 9,230 per sqm, positioning it among the most premium residential developments in Makati and the Philippines.

The EDGE-certified building incorporates sustainability features such as EV charging stations, rainwater harvesting systems, and energy-efficient technologies aligned with global environmental standards.

Ayala Land Premier has historically delivered 20% to 40% capital appreciation from pre-selling to turnover across its luxury projects, making Laurean an attractive opportunity for long-term wealth preservation and generational investment.

The Dela Rosa Gardens masterplan will also introduce retail, dining, and landscaped public spaces that create a new lifestyle hub within the Makati CBD, further strengthening the area’s residential appeal.
Foreign buyers may acquire units under condominium title subject to the 40% foreign ownership quota.

Where is the complex located?
Residential complex Alliance Centropolis in Batumi is being built in the central part of the city.
The exact location is 63 Rustaveli Avenue.
The new building is located on the first line from the coast, 50 meters from the sea and next to the beach.
The main attractions and entertainment facilities of the resort are located nearby, which makes the apartments in the complex an ideal option for a profitable investment.
Ardagani Park and Ardagani Lake, with its famous dancing fountains, are only 350 meters away.
What's around?

Near the complex are many different shops which include the Goodwill supermarket, fast food outlets, restaurants of local and European cuisine, a sushi-bar, cafes, pastry shops and bakeries, bank branches, dental clinics, and beauty salons.

Within a 5-10 minute walk is the Batumi Aquarium, the Dolphinarium, the Zoo, the Batumi Mall shopping and entertainment center, the Carrefour hypermarket, and many other urban infrastructure facilities.
How to get around?
The convenient transport links allow you to quickly reach any area of ​​the resort town and its suburbs.
The nearest stop is 360 meters from the multifunctional complex where buses No.
10,10A and 17 depart with a minimum interval of sixteen minutes The lower station of the "Argo" cable-car, the Batumi seaport, and the Old Bus Station are located three kilometers away.
The "Metro" bus terminal is five kilometers away.
The Batumi Central bus station and the Batumi-Passenger railway station are located at a distance of about six kilometers.
Chorokh International Airport is twelve minutes by car.
What are the technical features?

Alliance Centropolis includes: The first international exhibition center in the region (WTC) Residential complex with apartments 5-star hotel brand and casino Shopping center Business center The residential complex will consist of three buildings with a height of fifty floors, united by a stylobate and designed in the same style according to the original architectural project.
Construction is being carried out on an area of ​​over 18 thousand square meters.
The skyscrapers are constructed of high-quality building materials.
High structural strength and seismic resistance are provided by a reinforced concrete foundation and the monolithic frame.
The facades of the buildings will be decorated with stained glass windows.
The skyscrapers are equipped with high-speed freight and passenger elevators, innovative technological equipment, and necessary utilities, as well as fire alarms.
Halls and common areas are being designed.
There are a reception and a concierge desk at the entrance.
Amenities and facilities Alliance Centropolis is designed according to the city-within-a-city concept, which implies the presence of: Recreational area with an area of ​​about 10.000 sqm.

Underground three-level parking for 1000 cars, accessible by elevator Fitness center Restaurant Pool Bar Lounge bar Spa salon Entertainment center and cinema CCTV cameras are being installed throughout the territory and inside the buildings, and are monitored by security service.
Walkways, covered with paving slabs, are arranged around the buildings, street lighting devices are installed, and passages for special vehicles and cars are laid.
The landscaping is further enhanced with plants and trees.
Apartment owners have access to cleaning and maintenance services.
What kind of apartments are available?
The available units come in the form of studios, as well as units with one- and two-bedroom layouts.
The size of the apartments ranges from 29 to 74 square meters while the ceiling height is 2.75 meters.
The price includes white frame finishing.
The apartments have panoramic windows with energy-saving glazing, from which you can enjoy views of the sea and mountains.
The apartments can be purchased by making a lump-sum payment as well as with an interest-free installment plan for up to 48 months.
For this, you need to make a downpayment of 20% of the total price.
You can find out more about the terms of purchase on the official website or at the sales office.
Who is the developer?
Alliance Group, founded in 2008, is the developer of this complex.
Each project of the company is designed in a futuristic style, which is distinguished by its memorable architectural design and competent execution.
Over the years, the company has collected several prestigious awards and prizes.

Evlerin Fiyatları Ne Kadar?

Güncel fiyat bilgisi için bizimle iletişime geçebilirsiniz.
Finansman ve Ödeme Seçenekleri Sunuluyor mu?
Evet, farklı bütçelere uygun esnek ödeme planları ve banka kredisi imkânları sunuyoruz.
Konutlar Ne Zaman Teslim Edilecek?
Konutların teslim süreci, inşaatın tamamlanmasının hemen ardından başlayacak ve belirlenen tarihlerde gerçekleştirilecektir.
Bina Tamamlama Sigortası Nedir?
Bina Tamamlama Sigortası, bir konut veya ticari yapı projesinin tamamlanamaması durumunda hak sahiplerinin (örneğin konut alıcılarının) maddi kayıplarını güvence altına alan bir sigorta türüdür.
Sigorta Hangi Durumlarda Devreye Girer?
Müteahhidin iflası Sözleşme yükümlülüklerinin yerine getirilmemesi, İnşaatın belirtilen sürede tamamlanamaması gibi durumlarda sigorta devreye girer.
Sigorta Alıcıya Ne Gibi Haklar Sağlar?
Ödenen bedelin iadesi, Sözleşme yükümlülüklerinin yerine getirilmemesi, İnşaatın belirtilen sürede tamamlanamaması gibi durumlarda sigorta devreye girer.
Sigorta Süresi Ne Kadardır?
Sigorta inşaat süresini kapsar ve projenin tamamlanmasına kadar devam eder.
Bina Tamamlama Sigortası Zorunlu mudur?
Bina Tamamlama Sigortası, Türkiye'de 2024 itibarıyla, özellikle ön ödemeli konut satışlarında yani maketten satış yapılan projelerde tüketicilerin korunması amacıyla zorunlu hale gelmiştir.
