Yakup Uslu, CEO of Ideal & Partners.
By Dr.
Yakup Uslu · CEO, IDEAL & Partners · Alanya W hen a new project launches in Alanya, few people genuinely get excited.
Over the years, we have heard so many promises of “luxury,” “unrivalled,” and “the address of investment” that the words have lost much of their weight.
But occasionally — very rarely — something genuinely different comes along.
23 Square is one of those moments.
I recently visited the 23 Projects sales office, situated right beside the construction site.
Founders Erol Fazlıoğlu and Murat Bozkurt received me in their offices.
After two hours of conversation, one thing became clear: this project is the most comprehensive residential development Alanya has seen in the past decade.

——— IN THEIR OWN WORDS ——— EF Erol Fazlıoğlu Co-Founder, 23 Projects “When we designed 23 Square, we asked ourselves one question: as someone who lives in Alanya, which project would we want to live in?
The answer was none of them.
We set out to fill that gap.
Building only 203 apartments on 21,500 square metres is a commercially bold decision.
But there was no other way to avoid compromising on quality.” Fazlıoğlu’s words could sound like marketing rhetoric — but the numbers bear him out.
Comparable projects in Alanya build upwards of 400 units on similar plot sizes.
23 Square stops at 203.
That decision directly affects quality of life, density, and long-term value appreciation.
“We found a plot in Oba surrounded by roads on all four sides.
It creates the feeling of a private island.
The nearest neighbouring building is 54 metres away.

In Alanya today, that is no longer a luxury — it is a miracle.” — Erol Fazlıoğlu, Co-Founder, 23 Projects MB Murat Bozkurt Co-Founder, 23 Projects “We structured this project around three distinct buyer profiles: Gold, Ruby and Diamond Edition.
All three share the same construction quality, the same materials, the same social facilities.
The difference is only in square metres and positioning.
This way, a first-time investor and a buyer with a €1.2 million budget can both access the same quality environment.
We were the first to bring this concept to Alanya.” Bozkurt’s three-edition system is one of the primary reasons IDEAL & Partners chose to include this project in our portfolio.
Our international clients — from the UK, Germany, the Gulf states — come with different budgets but share one requirement: zero tolerance for quality compromise.
23 Square meets that requirement.
——— PROJECT FACTS AT A GLANCE ——— Location Oba District, Alanya / Antalya, Turkey Developer 23 Projects Total Apartments 203 units (1+1 to 4+1, incl.

duplexes) Plot Area 21,500 m² Blocks / Floors 11 blocks, 6 floors each Starting Price €226,098 (Gold Edition 1+1) Distance to Beach 750 metres Indoor Social Area 975 m² (Club 23) Underground Parking 9,200 m² / 276 spaces Commercial Units 23 retail shops (Shops 23) Delivery Date March 2027 Sales Partner Ideal & Partners The project’s most striking technical detail may be its ground conditions.
Earthquake resilience has risen sharply up the agenda of international buyers in recent years.
23 Square is built on rocky ground, with a foundation bearing capacity of 5 according to the Ground Investigation Report — one of the highest readings recorded for a residential site in the region.
“A 9,200 square metre underground car park is a first for Alanya.
It is expensive to build.
But residents should not run through the rain to reach their car.

This is not a matter of choice — it is a matter of standard.” — Murat Bozkurt, Co-Founder, 23 Projects Payment Plans — Up to 36 Months 23 Square offers six distinct payment models — from 100% cash through to a 35% down payment plus 36 monthly instalments.
At Ideal & Partners, we provide independent financial advisory to all clients, evaluating which plan is genuinely advantageous in the long term, including currency risk and rental yield projections.
For buyers interested in Turkish citizenship by investment: individual or combined purchases at 23 Square can meet the qualifying threshold.
Our team provides end-to-end legal support for citizenship applications through specialist partner firms.

Full Project Details — IDEAL & Partners Pricing tables, payment plans, apartment types and more: www.idealandpartners.com/23-square-alanya-luxury-apartments-for-sale/ The IDEAL & Partners Perspective I have been working in Alanya for over a decade.
In that time I have observed hundreds of projects and dozens of developers at close range.
What distinguishes the 23 Projects team is not only the quality of their construction — it is their approach after handover, and the way they build long-term relationships with residents.
In the Mediterranean real estate market, that remains a rare quality.
Alanya continues in 2026 to be one of the most active foreign investment destinations on Europe’s Mediterranean coastline.

The current currency advantage, Turkey’s citizenship programme and the expanding connectivity of Gazipasa Airport combine to create an exceptional window for buyers who position themselves correctly and at the right time.
23 Square sits at the centre of that window.

ARCHIVED ARTICLE - The first phase of the Siena development will bring high-end apartments to La Manga Club & Resort by February 2028 A major new housing development is on the way to La Manga Club after British builder Taylor Wimpey confirmed a €26 million investment in the area.
The project, which will be known as Siena, will be the company’s first development in La Manga and signals a fresh push to expand further along Spain’s Mediterranean coast.
Taylor Wimpey is one of the UK’s largest housebuilders, with a long track record of residential developments both in Britain and overseas.
Its Spanish division has been active for decades, focusing mainly on high quality homes in popular coastal locations aimed at international buyers.
According to details released by the company earlier this week, the first phase of Siena will consist of modern three bedroom, two bathroom apartments.
These will be split between ground floor properties with private gardens and terraces, and upper floor homes featuring terraces and rooftop solariums.
The development will be built within the well-known La Manga Club resort, giving residents access to a wide range of facilities.
The resort is home to 11 restaurants, along with golf courses and a spa linked to the five star hotel operated by Hyatt.
Buyers can expect shared spaces designed for both relaxation and family life.
Plans include swimming pools, landscaped gardens, a children’s play area and a dedicated space that could be used as a gym or multi purpose room.
Construction of this first phase is expected to be completed by February 2028.
Looking ahead, a second phase is already in the pipeline.
This will introduce townhouses and villas, also with three bedrooms, offering more choice for buyers looking to settle in the area.
These properties are set to be positioned to make the most of sunlight, with most facing south, east or west.
Like the initial phase, the next stage will also include communal facilities such as pools, gardens, a play area and a gym.
"Owning a home in a renowned resort like La Manga Club offers buyers exceptional added value.
We are delighted that Siena will be contributing high-quality homes that live up to this idyllic location," said Marc Pritchard, Marketing and Sales Director at Taylor Wimpey Spain.

The starting price of units in Tiger Downtown Ajman is 366,000 AED.
Who is the owner of Tiger Downtown Ajman?
Tiger Downtown Ajman is developed and owned by Tiger Group .
The company is responsible for the full project lifecycle, including master planning, design direction, construction execution, and delivery of the residential community.
What is the Payment Plan of Tiger Downtown Ajman ?
Tiger Downtown Ajman follows a 70/30 payment structure designed across construction and post-handover stages.

20% down payment at booking 40% paid during construction in installments 10% on handover 30% paid after handover over a post-handover period This structure splits the total cost into four clear phases.
Buyers pay a smaller entry amount first, continue payments during the build period, then settle a final portion at handover, with the remaining balance extended after receiving the property.
Is Tiger Downtown Ajman a good investment?
Tiger Downtown Ajman presents a strong investment case based on its scale, design, and mixed-use planning.
The project includes lagoon-front and perimeter buildings, with 06 initial towers offering studios, 1–3 bedroom apartments, duplexes from 2–4 bedrooms, and 6-bedroom penthouses.
This wide unit mix supports different tenant profiles, increasing rental demand across multiple segments.
A total of 20 lagoon-front buildings and 56 perimeter buildings are planned within the community, creating a large but structured township.
The master plan is organized around water features, green zones, and active corridors, which improves daily livability and strengthens long-term occupancy potential.
Fully furnished units reduce upfront furnishing costs for buyers and speed up rental readiness.
Shared amenities include landscaped green areas, social gathering spaces, walking zones, and recreational facilities integrated throughout the development.
The combination of waterfront positioning, diverse housing types, and a fully planned community environment creates consistent rental appeal and resale potential.
Is Tiger Downtown Ajman Freehold or leasehold?
Tiger Downtown Ajman is a freehold development, allowing full ownership of the property with a permanent, registered title deed.
When is Tiger Downtown Ajman's Delivery date?
Tiger Downtown Ajman is scheduled for delivery in December 2028.
This date marks the completion of construction works, finishing of residential units, and handover of the apartments to buyers according to the project timeline.
Where is Tiger Downtown Ajman Located?
Tiger Downtown Ajman is located in Al Alia area, Ajman, within the Tiger Downtown Ajman master development in the United Arab Emirates.
What are the housing options of Tiger Downtown Ajman?
Tiger Downtown Ajman offers a structured range of residential units divided into apartments, duplexes, and penthouses, designed to serve different buyer segments and investment levels.
The apartment category starts with studios priced from 366,000 AED, followed by 1-bedroom units from 719,000 AED.
The range continues with 2-bedroom apartments from 954,000 AED, while 3-bedroom apartments start from 1.3 million AED.
The largest apartment option is the 4-bedroom unit starting from 4.2 million AED.
These apartments are part of a fully furnished concept across the development, which supports immediate rental use after handover.
In addition to apartments, the project includes duplex units.
These come in 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and 4-bedroom configurations, designed for larger living spaces, though pricing is listed as coming soon.
At the top end, Tiger Downtown Ajman includes 6-bedroom penthouses, offering the highest level of space and exclusivity within the project, also currently marked as coming soon in pricing.
This mix of studios, apartments, duplexes, and penthouses creates a complete residential structure, covering entry-level investors up to high-end buyers within one integrated lagoon-front community.

from €475 000 82-124 m 2 82-124 m 2 30 lots 30 lots 2-3 bedrooms 2-3 Frequently Asked Questions Is it possible to get a residence permit in Cyprus now?
Yes - as at mid-2023, both a residence permit and a permanent residence permit are issued by the Cypriot authorities.
Moreover, there are no prohibitions based on nationality and, for example, citizens of the Russian Federation also successfully become residents of the country.
There are more than ten ways to get a residence permit.
This is , for example, a student visa, a residence permit for financially independent persons, digital nomads, a residence permit based on employment, an investment Fast Track ...
Of course, since the pandemic, many coordination procedures have taken longer than usual, but the country's authorities have not imposed any restrictions.
But there are many nuances in the process, so each case requires individual consideration.
Is it possible to open a bank account in Cyprus now?
Foreign citizens can still open a Cypriot bank account.
Only citizens of the Russian Federation and Belarus have difficulties.
Most likely if you just come from the street in 2023, they will not open an account for you.
And it is important that the “source of funds” is not associated with sanctioned activities.
In practice, the list of incomes considered "sanctioned" has recently been expanding.
An exception, for example, is the income received from the rental of real estate.
By the way, it is not necessary to have your own bank account to buy a property if you are in Cyprus.
But having already purchased it, and furthermore, having received permanent residence, both Russians and Belarusians can open an account.

However, one must be prepared for the fact that checks (including the origin of funds) by banks have become tougher, although not particularly lengthened - the process takes, as before, about 2 weeks.
What the purchase procedure in Cyprus looks like The main steps are as follows: verification of the buyer - including a banking verification.

This is the most important, now necessary step, allowing to assess whether you can actually make a deal selection of a property (on-site or remote) and simultaneous submission of documents to the bank prepaid reservation conclusion of an agreement (with a description of the terms of payment) payment for the property registration of property rights, receipt of supporting documents.
Depending on the details of a specific transaction, additional checks and preparation of documents are possible at different steps of the procedure.
Why is it profitable to buy real estate through an agency and not on your own?
Just note that it makes sense to contact (and communicate) with a reliable and professional company - with a history and positive reviews.
Firstly, you involve specialists who understand the market, prices, offers, and the transaction procedure as assistants.
They will help solve problems in an unfamiliar country with its own specifics.
Second, you can find a company that speaks your language.
You will be helped to organize viewings, collect documents, agree on deadlines and arrange necessary meetings and procedures.
Thirdly, in many cases you can expect the price to come even down for a particular object - serious agencies usually have "special conditions" when dealing with developers.
You should not hope for huge discounts, but you definitely won’t overpay.
Finally, a good agency will help you resolve issues that are not directly related to the purchase.
Teaching children, settling in a new place, searching for a master or a specialist of any profile - the needs can be very different.
What advantages does tax residency in Cyprus offer?
Cyprus is not an offshore jurisdiction, but it offers favorable tax conditions for those who become tax residents of the country.
You can become a tax resident by residing in Cyprus for more than 183 days a year or if you: - Reside in Cyprus for at least 60 days in a tax year.
- Do not live in another country for more than 183 days during the tax year.
- Are not a tax resident of another country.
- Have property in Cyprus, either owned or rented.
In this case, you may qualify for Non-Domicile tax residency, where you are exempt from paying the Special Defense Contribution (SDC).
The following are not subject to taxation: - Dividend income.
- Interest income from deposits.
- Rental income from real estate (except for income tax).
You also do not pay tax on income outside of Cyprus, securities sales tax, inheritance taxes, gifts, and luxury taxes.
These are just some of the advantages.
For more detailed information, we recommend contacting us directly.
Is it possible to buy property in Cyprus remotely?
Yes, such transactions are practiced, especially when purchasing property at an early stage of construction or even before it begins when there is no opportunity to see the finished property.
For example, our company facilitates the process by conducting online tours, showcasing potential options and areas, as well as addressing any questions and concerns that arise.
The key aspect of this scheme is to find a trusted individual or company that will represent your interests, and then prepare, sign, and apostille a notarized power of attorney in their name.

sale Apartments Poreč sale Houses sale Kaštela Frequently Asked Questions What are the advantages of buying a new construction property?
Buying a new construction property offers numerous benefits: energy efficiency, modern construction standards, contemporary architecture, and lower maintenance costs.
Such properties often come with new installations, contractor warranties, and the possibility of personalizing the interior before moving in.
New constructions are particularly attractive to those who want long-term value and a peaceful life without additional investments immediately after purchase.
Is there a warranty on new construction properties?

Yes, according to the Construction Act, investors are required to provide a warranty for hidden defects for a minimum of 2 years, while for certain parts of the building (construction, waterproofing, etc.) it can be longer.
When buying from a reputable investor, you can get additional warranty conditions.
Our agency works exclusively with verified projects and ensures warranty transparency.
Can I buy a new construction property that is still under construction?

Yes, it is possible to buy an apartment or a house while the project is still under construction, which is called "purchase based on a preliminary contract." This option often allows for a more favorable price and the ability to choose interior materials (tiles, parquet, wall colors).
In this case, payments are made in phases, and the agency monitors the construction progress and ensures that all contract conditions are met.
How does buying a new construction differ from buying an old property?
With new construction, you buy the property directly from the investor, which means that in most cases you do not pay real estate transfer tax (3%), because VAT is already included in the price.
Also, the documentation is modern, technically correct and there is no need for adaptation.
On the other hand, with older properties, additional investments, legality checks and more attention are often needed when buying.
What does the price of a new construction include?
The price depends on the project, location and equipment.
In most cases, all construction work, connections, parquet, ceramics, sanitary ware and basic lighting are included.
A garage space, storage room or interior design according to the buyer's wishes are often paid extra.
Our agents can provide you with a complete cost estimate and suggestions for personalization within the project.
Can new constructions be purchased with a housing loan?
Yes, most banks in Croatia are happy to finance the purchase of new buildings, especially if they are projects with proper documentation and a use permit.
If the project is under construction, payments are made in phases under the supervision of the bank.
Our team can connect you with loan advisors and help you prepare the necessary documentation.
When can I move into an apartment purchased in a new building?
You can move in as soon as the project receives a use permit and you fulfill all financial obligations (payment of the price, signing the contract).
If the project is in the final phase, moving in is possible within a few weeks.
In the earlier stages, the agent will inform you about the expected completion date and payment dynamics.
What is a use permit and why is it important?
A use permit is an official document that confirms that the building was built in accordance with the building permit and can be safely used.
Without a use permit, it is not possible to legally move in or register ownership in the land register.
When buying through our agency, we always ensure that the project has or will have a use permit by the time of delivery.
What is the role of the agency when buying a new construction?

The Regent agency provides you with: advice on project selection, insight into the cost estimate and technical specifications, assistance in negotiations and reservations, legal check of documentation, communication with the investor, bank and notary.
With us, you buy more safely and informed - without unpleasant surprises.
Are there projects available with a "turnkey" purchase option?
Yes, our offer includes projects with a "turnkey" option, where the property is fully finished and ready to move in, including a bathroom, kitchen, floors, lighting and, if desired, furniture.
This option saves time and additional costs, and is particularly popular with buyers from abroad.
What should I pay attention to when buying a new construction?
Buying a new building has many advantages, but it is important to ensure that the property meets all the conditions for a safe and quality investment.
The key factor is the reliability of the investor and contractor - their past reputation can give you an insight into the quality of construction and adherence to deadlines.

In order to ensure a carefree purchase process, our expert team checks all relevant documentation, including the building and use permit, to make sure that the property is legally built and ready for occupancy.
We also take care of the quality of materials and finishing works and provide you with professional advice to make the right decision.

With us, you do not have to go through this process alone - we offer expert support in all phases of the purchase, from negotiations with the investor to checking the contract and organizing a technical inspection of the property.
What are the hidden costs when buying a new construction?
In addition to the purchase price itself, when buying a new building, additional costs may arise that are important to consider.
One of them is the cost of furnishing the apartment, as new buildings often come without built-in furniture or a kitchen.
Some investors offer parking spaces or garages for an additional fee, which can also be an additional cost.

It is advisable to study the sales contract in detail and consult with the agency that represents you to make sure that all costs are clearly defined and that there are no unpleasant surprises after the purchase.

Request Information Request a Virtual Presentation 1880 Brickell Avenue, Miami, FL 33129 Where Elegance Meets Serenity Rising five stories on nearly one acre between South Brickell and Coconut Grove, Colette Residences is a boutique sanctuary of just 38 residences and 2 extraordinary penthouses.
Here, residential calm balances contemporary sophistication in an interconnected design that celebrates light, air, and artisan detail.

Conceived by Meta Development with interiors by Brazilian design group OSPA and architecture by Bellon Architecture, every home is defined by custom Italian millwork by CESAR, walk-in closets by LEMA, and finishes that honor the art of craftsmanship.

38 Residences 55 ft Height 2-4 Bedrooms 5 Stories 15000 SF of Amenities Building Details Colette Residences at a Glance Address 1880 Brickell Avenue, Miami, FL 33129 Developer Meta Development Architect Bellon Architecture Residences 38 Stories 5 Building Type Condominium Neighborhood Brickell What Makes It Special Why Buyers Choose Colette Residences Boutique Living on Lower Brickell Avenue Colette Residences at 1880 Brickell Avenue is a five-story boutique development from Meta Development, and its scale is precisely what makes it compelling.

In a corridor dominated by 50-plus-story towers, a five-story building designed by Bellon Architecture offers something genuinely different - intimacy, exclusivity, and a residential character that high-rises cannot deliver.
We advise clients regularly who love the Brickell location but do not want to live in a tower with 400 neighbors.
Colette answers that need.
With just five stories, you are looking at a limited number of residences, which means fewer people in the elevator, at the pool, and in your life.
Bellon Architecture's Parisian-Inflected Design Bellon Architecture brings a design sensibility to Colette Residences that draws on European traditions of residential elegance.
The name itself - Colette - evokes Parisian sophistication, and the architectural approach delivers on that promise.
At five stories, the building's proportions allow for the kind of detailing and facade articulation that gets lost on a 60-story glass tower.
Our team appreciates buildings that feel designed rather than engineered, and Colette falls firmly in that camp.

The lower scale also enables more generous ceiling heights, thoughtful landscaping at ground level, and an entrance experience that feels like arriving at a private residence rather than a commercial building.

The 1880 Brickell Address Advantage The 1880 Brickell Avenue address places Colette in the southern stretch of Brickell, which our brokerage considers one of the most livable sections of the corridor.
You are far enough from the density of Brickell City Centre to enjoy relative quiet, but close enough to walk to everything the neighborhood offers.
This section of Brickell also benefits from proximity to the Brickell Key waterfront, Simpson Park, and the residential calm of the Roads neighborhood.
We work in this area frequently, and the micro-location at 1880 feels decidedly more residential than the commercial intensity of northern Brickell.
For buyers who want a Brickell address without the Brickell chaos, this is the right stretch.
A Rare Product Type in a Tower-Dominated Market From an investment perspective, Colette Residences occupies a niche that is dramatically undersupplied in Brickell.
Low-rise boutique luxury simply does not exist in meaningful quantity along Brickell Avenue, which means Colette will compete with a very small set of comparables at resale.

Meta Development has identified a gap in the market - there are buyers willing to pay a premium for privacy, exclusivity, and architectural character, and those buyers currently have almost nowhere to go in Brickell.
We believe this scarcity creates a durable value proposition.
When supply is this limited and demand is this consistent, pricing tends to hold well through market cycles.
Advisor Perspective Our Take on Colette Residences Miami Colette Residences is one of those projects that stands out precisely because it refuses to follow the prevailing formula.

At five stories on Brickell Avenue, designed by Bellon Architecture and developed by Meta Development, this is a building that chooses intimacy over scale - and we think there is a real market for that choice.
The pros are clear and specific.
The boutique scale means an exceptionally small resident community, which translates to genuine privacy and a sense of exclusivity that tower living cannot provide.
Bellon Architecture has delivered a design that feels curated and European rather than mass-produced, with proportions and details that benefit from the lower height.
The 1880 Brickell Avenue location hits a sweet spot between convenience and calm.
And the sheer rarity of this product type in Brickell means the competitive set at resale will be extremely limited.

Leasehold or freehold: which is better?
Each has its advantages, and we would not steer a buyer to one over the other in the abstract.
Freehold is title in perpetuity: the home is yours outright, it passes to your heirs without a clock on it, and it is the simpler asset to finance and to sell to the widest pool of buyers.

Leasehold is normally structured to 90 years, as a 30-year registered term with two further 30-year terms written into the contract in Thailand, or as a 99-year term in markets such as Singapore, and it is the route to a villa on its own land where the law keeps freehold land in local hands.

On resale a lease is assigned rather than a title transferred, which in Thailand means a fraction of the transfer fees and taxes a freehold sale attracts, and a well-run branded estate keeps its resale value on the strength of the operator and the address rather than the tenure.
What matters is the specific home: the years left on the term, how the renewals are secured, and what the purchase pack says about assignment.
We put those three questions to the developer or the seller's side before any offer, and we tell you what comes back.

Muriya is one of Oman's foremost developers of Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITCs) — large, master-planned seaside towns that blend freehold homes, hotels, marinas and leisure into a single destination.

Founded in 2006 as a joint venture between Orascom Development Holding , the Swiss-listed integrated-town specialist behind El Gouna and Andermatt, and OMRAN Group , Oman's government tourism-investment arm, Muriya builds and operates two of the Sultanate's flagship coastal destinations: Jebel Sifah near Muscat and Hawana Salalah in Dhofar.

2006 Founded Muscat, Sultanate of Oman Headquarters Two flagship ITC destinations with multiple delivered communities and over 1,000 homes handed over Projects delivered View Muriya About Jebel Sifah Muriya's marina-and-golf resort where the Hajar Mountains meet the Gulf of Oman.

Jebel Sifah is one of Oman's most established Integrated Tourism Complexes — a 6.2 million sqm coastal resort master-developed by Muriya (the Orascom Development × OMRAN joint venture), set roughly 35–45 minutes south-east of Muscat where almost 6 km of natural coastline meets the Al Hajar Mountains.

Life here orbits an 84-berth marina (plus 115 dry berths), a 9-hole, par-36 Harradine-designed golf course and the Sifawy Boutique Hotel , with beach clubs, a dive and watersports centre, horse stables and waterfront dining.

As a designated ITC it grants 100% freehold ownership to buyers of any nationality , and with 1,500+ residents from over 20 nationalities already settled it is a resort that lives year-round, not just in season.
Entry-level studios start from around OMR 35,000 , with apartments, farmhouses and golf-front villas above.

Terraces up to 149 sqm, 20% down, 60% over 36 months, completion June 2030.
Sea La Vie is Dar Global’s newest address on Qetaifan Island North, the man-made leisure island at the northern edge of Lusail.
Its five residential floors rise above the island’s palm-lined marina promenade, a minute from Meryal Waterpark, Azure Beach and Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North.
Sea, marina, entertainment: the project’s own strapline describes the setting precisely.
For a buyer who wants a waterfront home in Qatar that works as a weekend retreat, a base close to Lusail and Doha or a place for longer family stays, the island does much of the work.
Every home shares one clear arrangement: a bedroom, a separate den and two bathrooms.
Fourteen layouts, from Type A to Type D1, turn that arrangement into very different homes.
Internal areas run from 79 to 111 sqm, and total areas from about 88 to 253 sqm once balconies and terraces are included.
Some apartments are efficient city homes with a balcony; others, mainly on the third to fifth floors, open onto terraces of 92 to 149 sqm, larger than the apartment itself.
The den becomes a guest room, a children’s room, a study or a media room as your life requires.
Prices start from QAR 1,874,950, about USD 514,500.
The payment plan asks for 20% on booking, six instalments of 10% every six months to month 36, and the final 20% on completion, which is anticipated in June 2030.
Qetaifan Island North lies within Lusail’s freehold area, so international buyers can own outright in their own name.
Dar Global’s factsheet lists a 1% registration fee, a developer charge that sits alongside the Ministry of Justice’s 0.25% transfer fee, and estimated service charges of QAR 12 to 20 per sqm.
Omnia advises the buyer.

We’ll help you compare the fourteen layouts by floor, outdoor space and outlook, request current availability and the exact price of the homes that suit your brief, and explain the payment schedule and running costs before you reserve.
Floor plans are shared on request.
On a visit to the island we can also show you Dar Global’s neighbouring Les Vagues by Elie Saab and L’Horizon by Elie Saab , so you can compare the addresses side by side.

Who can own Qetaifan Island North sits within Lusail, one of Qatar’s designated freehold areas, and the developer offers Sea La Vie with 100% foreign ownership.
International buyers can hold freehold title in their own name with no time limit.
A qualifying purchase in Qatar can also support a residence application.
We confirm the current rules, your eligibility and the title recorded on your specific apartment in writing before you commit.

Qatar levies no personal income tax and no capital gains tax.

The riyal is pegged to the US dollar, so buyers earning in sterling, euros or other currencies carry exchange exposure across the 36-month schedule.

In detail A closer reading.
Fourteen layouts built around one plan Sea La Vie is deliberately focused.
Rather than a ladder of studios to penthouses, every apartment is a one bedroom plus den with two bathrooms, and the choice lies in how that plan meets the outdoors.
Types A, A1 and A7 appear on every floor from the first to the fifth, so they offer the widest choice of height and outlook.
Types A2, A5, B, B1, C and D sit on two to four floors each.
Types A3, A4, A6, A8 and D1 occur on a single floor, which makes them the scarcest layouts in the building.
Internal areas range from 79 sqm in Types A and A1 to 111 sqm in Type B.
Terraces that change the way you live The upper floors hold Sea La Vie’s most distinctive homes.
Type D1 on the fifth floor pairs 104 sqm inside with a 149 sqm terrace, for 253 sqm in total.
Type A6 on the fourth floor has a 134 sqm terrace, Type A3 on the fifth floor 121 sqm, and Type A4 on the third floor 92 sqm.
Selected Type A and A1 units reach terraces of up to 131 and 133 sqm.
A terrace of this size becomes an outdoor living room for winter evenings, family lunches and entertaining.
Layouts such as A7, A2 and C carry balconies of 8 to 42 sqm for those who prefer a lighter, more compact home.

Inside the apartments Homes are delivered unfurnished, with the kitchen fully equipped: a fridge, hob and oven, extractor hood, dishwasher and washing machine are included, with engineered stone worktops and laminate-finish cabinetry.
Floors and skirting throughout are porcelain tile or equivalent, under gypsum ceilings.
The living room has a wallcovering accent wall; bedrooms add built-in joinery and a fitted headboard with wallpaper.
Bathrooms are tiled in porcelain with engineered stone countertops.
Full-height glazing in the developer’s interior renders frames the water from the living room and main bedroom.
Ask us for the specification schedule attached to your chosen unit.
Building amenities Residents have an infinity swimming pool, a fitness centre and a landscaped courtyard with sea views.
A 24-hour reception desk, four elevators including a service elevator, and residents’ parking handle the practical side of daily life.
Public areas are furnished and designed by the developer, and luxury retail at street level adds everyday convenience.
With the island’s beaches, waterpark and restaurants close by, the building concentrates on the essentials and leaves the entertainment to the setting.
Life on Qetaifan Island North Qetaifan Island North covers about 1.3 million sqm and is crossed by a 1.3 km canal.
Meryal Waterpark has 36 rides, and its Rig 1938 tower has been recognised by Guinness World Records as the tallest water slide tower in the world, at around 85 metres.
Azure Beach club, Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North and the island’s entertainment district are each about a minute away, alongside souqs, retail plazas, cafes and restaurants.
Lusail Boulevard is about two minutes by car, Place Vendôme mall about five and the Lusail Marina Promenade about seven.
Connected to Lusail and Doha The island is reached from Lusail, Qatar’s planned waterfront city north of Doha.

The developer gives approximate drive times of 10 minutes to Katara Cultural Village, 12 minutes to The Pearl-Qatar, 15 minutes to West Bay, 18 minutes to the Doha Corniche and 25 minutes to Hamad International Airport.
That makes Sea La Vie practical as a primary home for someone working in Lusail or West Bay, and easy to reach for an owner flying in for weekends and holidays.
The payment plan in practice At the starting price of QAR 1,874,950, the 20% booking payment is QAR 374,990.
Six instalments of 10%, or QAR 187,495 each at that price, fall due 6, 12, 18, 24, 30 and 36 months after booking.
The final 20% is paid on completion, anticipated in June 2030.
Payments are made in Qatari riyals by bank transfer or manager’s cheque to the developer’s account named in your sale documents.
Because the riyal is pegged to the US dollar, a buyer earning in another currency should plan for exchange movements across the 36-month schedule.

The terrace homes on the upper floors suit those who live outdoors for much of the year.

Read the full detail Questions & answers What buyers ask us.
Where is Sea La Vie?
+ Sea La Vie is on the marina waterfront of Qetaifan Island North, the leisure island reached from Lusail, north of Doha in Qatar.
Meryal Waterpark, Azure Beach and Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North are each about a minute away.
Who is developing Sea La Vie?
+ Sea La Vie is developed and sold by Dar Global, the London-listed international arm of Saudi developer Dar Al Arkan.
Dar Global also developed Les Vagues and L’Horizon by Elie Saab on the same island.
How much does a Sea La Vie apartment cost?
+ Prices start from QAR 1,874,950, about USD 514,500.
The price of each unit depends on its layout, floor and outdoor space.
Ask our team for current availability and the exact price of the homes that interest you.
What types of apartment are available?
+ Every apartment is a one bedroom plus den with two bathrooms.
There are fourteen layouts, Types A to A8, B, B1, C, D and D1, which differ in internal size, floor and the size of balcony or terrace.
How big are the apartments?
+ Internal areas range from 79 to 111 sqm.
Including balconies and terraces, total areas range from about 88 to 253 sqm, the largest being Type D1 on the fifth floor.
Which apartments have the largest terraces?
+ Type D1 has a 149 sqm terrace, Type A6 134 sqm, Type A3 121 sqm and Type A4 92 sqm.
Selected Type A and A1 units have terraces of up to 131 and 133 sqm.
These homes sit on the third to fifth floors.
What is the payment plan?
+ 20% on booking, then six instalments of 10% at 6, 12, 18, 24, 30 and 36 months from booking, and the final 20% on completion.
At the starting price, the booking payment is QAR 374,990 and each instalment QAR 187,495.
When will Sea La Vie be completed?
+ The developer anticipates completion in June 2030.
As with any off-plan purchase, confirm the contractual completion date and its terms in your sale documents.
Can foreigners buy at Sea La Vie?
+ Yes.
Qetaifan Island North is within Lusail’s freehold area and Sea La Vie is offered with 100% foreign ownership, with freehold title in the buyer’s own name.
We confirm the current rules and your eligibility before you commit.
What fees and service charges should I expect?
+ Dar Global’s factsheet lists a 1% registration fee, separate from the Ministry of Justice’s 0.25% transfer fee, and estimated service charges of QAR 12 to 20 per sqm.
We’ll confirm the service-charge basis and prepare a full cost breakdown for your chosen unit.
Are the apartments furnished?
+ No.
Apartments are delivered unfurnished, with a fully equipped kitchen including fridge, hob and oven, extractor hood, dishwasher and washing machine, plus built-in bedroom joinery.
What amenities does the building have?

+ An infinity swimming pool, a fitness centre, a landscaped courtyard with sea views, a 24-hour reception desk, four elevators including a service elevator, residents’ parking, designed public areas and luxury retail.
How far is Sea La Vie from Doha and the airport?

+ The developer gives approximate drive times of 2 minutes to Lusail Boulevard, 10 minutes to Katara Cultural Village, 12 minutes to The Pearl-Qatar, 15 minutes to West Bay, 18 minutes to the Doha Corniche and 25 minutes to Hamad International Airport.
Is this the same Sea La Vie as the project in Abu Dhabi?
This Sea La Vie is Dar Global’s apartment building on Qetaifan Island North in Qatar.
A separate project with a similar name in Abu Dhabi is by a different developer and is not related.
How does Sea La Vie compare with Les Vagues and L’Horizon?
+ All three are Dar Global addresses on Qetaifan Island North.

Les Vagues offers one to three bedroom Elie Saab branded apartments and L’Horizon two-bedroom Elie Saab residences, while Sea La Vie focuses on one bedroom plus den apartments, many with large terraces, close to the island’s entertainment.
Can I see floor plans and arrange a viewing?
Send us your budget and preferred layouts and we’ll share floor plans, current availability and prices, then arrange a visit to Qetaifan Island North with our team.

Timezone Local Currency Welcome to your Azul Paraíso construction update.

I have great news to share… Construction is moving into the final stages, condos are showing impressive uplifts of as much as $252,000 from the RETA-only pricing, and the luxury brands arriving in Guanacaste are making this region one of the most exciting markets in the Americas right now.
Full details on all of the above in today’s update.
But first, here’s the latest update directly from the developer: Hi everyone, My name is Carlos “Charlie” Ramírez Sandí, and I work for Garnier & Garnier, the developer of Azul Paraíso.
Construction is progressing well.
The concrete and steel framework is now complete across all homes—a significant milestone.
The structural framework is complete.
Azul Paraíso is rising.
The team is working from the bottom up on the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing installations and finishes.

This includes: Mechanical: HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning), ductwork, and A/C equipment Electrical: Wiring, conduit, distribution boards, and lighting rough-ins Plumbing: Supply and waste pipework, drainage runs Masonry work is underway.
Glazing began on the lower levels.
The construction team is on site seven days per week, and the first deliveries are expected to take place in the late 3 rd quarter of 2026.
Thank you for your patience and continued confidence in this project.
Charlie Thanks, Charlie!
Now that Charlie has covered the construction progress, let me share why the fundamentals of Azul Paraíso remain so strong.
There are very few developments in the area with Azul Paraíso’s combination of great location, stunning views, and high-end amenities.
No wonder RETA members are already seeing significant uplifts.
This developer render should not be considered final but gives you an idea of what to expect.
With Azul Paraíso, you’ll own in an exclusive boutique community with spectacular ocean views.
The hillside setting means those views will always be there—nothing but jungle flowing down to the crystal-clear waters below.
Head to the infinity pool and you’ve got an expansive terrace and sweeping ocean views.
There will be a yoga deck, grilling area, and plenty of shared outdoor spaces for those long tropical evenings.
The sun goes down on another beautiful day at Playas del Coco, just 10 minutes from Azul Paraíso.
Spectacular sunsets like this will become part of your everyday life here.
Five minutes down the road will be your private beach club on Playa Ocotal—a beautiful curve of volcanic sand flanked by rocky bluffs.
This is one of the best snorkeling spots in the region, with tropical fish visible right off the beach.
It’s not just snorkeling either.
The beach is ideal for kayaking and paddleboarding as well as swimming.
Or you can hire a fishing charter and head offshore to catch your supper.
The waters are full of fish including snapper and mahi mahi.
As an owner at Azul Paraíso, you’ll enjoy beautiful views from your private balcony.
Just 10 minutes away is Playas del Coco—one of Costa Rica’s most beloved beach towns.
It’s set on a wide, calm bay good for swimming, and you can find fishing charters, sunset cruises, snorkeling tours and more.
The malecón that runs along the waterfront is lined with open-air restaurants as well as shops, artisan craft stores, supermarkets stocked with imported and gourmet goods, medical clinics, and banks.
About 50 minutes away, Brasilito is where locals go for fresh-caught seafood.
You will find rustic open-air restaurants right on the water where you can order whatever came in that morning.
There’s a farmer’s market on weekends too.
Tamarindo is the region’s surf hub, with lessons available year-round and a lively restaurant and bar scene that comes alive in the evenings.
It’s a 75-minute drive from Azul Paraíso.
Golf lovers are spoiled for choice.
The Arnold Palmer Signature Ocean Course on the Papagayo Peninsula, the Robert Trent Jones Jr.
course at Reserva Conchal, Hacienda Pinilla, and the Papagayo Country Club are all within reach.

And then there are the eco-adventures Costa Rica is famous for—ziplining through the jungle canopy, birdwatching, horseback riding on wild beaches, hiking to active volcanoes in Rincón de la Vieja National Park, soaking in natural hot springs.
The Rio Celeste, a river that runs a brilliant mineral blue, is worth the trip alone.
From surf towns to volcanic hot springs — Azul Paraíso puts some of Costa Rica’s best experiences on your doorstep.
Huge Uplifts on the RETA-only Pricing With the first deliveries just months away, the developer has continued to raise retail prices at Azul Paraíso, and RETA members are seeing significant uplifts.
A condo available to RETA members at $278,900 is now priced at $525,000.
An uplift of $246,100 .
A condo available to RETA members at $296,400 is now priced at $549,000.
An uplift of $252,000 .
A condo available to RETA members at $348,600 is now priced at $559,000.
An uplift of $210,400 .
Congratulations on getting in on this deal.
RETA members who bought in Azul Paraíso have seen uplifts of as high as $252,000 and up.
Record Numbers to Liberia Airport Guanacaste is on a remarkable growth trajectory—and the numbers at Liberia International Airport tell the story.

Liberia International Airport has broken its own passenger record three years in a row: In 2025 the airport posted a record 1.97 million passengers— a 3.3% increase on 2024 Peak season demand has been unprecedented.

A single day in late December 2025 hit 13,815 travelers — a new all-time high, 7% above the previous record And 2026 is already running further ahead — the first quarter alone posted 793,075 passengers, the busiest three months in the airport’s history, up 12% on the same period last year It’s not hard to see why so many people are coming.
Dozens of stunning beaches, charming coastal towns, and tropical weather draw expats, snowbirds, investors, and tourists in droves.
Direct flights connect Guanacaste to cities right across North America.
And once people get here, they keep coming back.
Access is set to improve further still.

The Costa Rican government has earmarked roughly $100 million for an upgrade of Route 21—the road that runs from Liberia Airport south through Guanacaste, connecting the airport to virtually every major beach destination in the region.
When Route 21 is upgraded, the entire region will become more accessible.
Big-name luxury brands are already positioning themselves.
Nekajui, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve and the brand’s first property in Central and South America, opened last year.
So did the Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica.
Later this year, JW Marriott will open its first-ever all-inclusive resort in Costa Rica, right here in Guanacaste—the first all-inclusive JW Marriott in the world.
And the St Regis Papagayo is actively taking shape for 2028 with 143 branded private residences starting at $3 million.
These are massive brands with huge budgets for market research.
They see the same case for investing here that you did—and they’re betting big on Guanacaste’s future.
These brands will enhance the appeal of the region and introduce a new wave of wealthy visitors.

When those visitors decide they want to return (and don’t want to pay thousands of dollars a night for the privilege) they’ll find your listing online: the same resort-style amenities, the same privileged location, at a fraction of the price.
With a real lack of comparable inventory, your condo at Azul Paraíso will stand out.

Ika Mare es un proyecto residencial beachfront de lujo ubicado en el sector Costa Azul de Santa Marta, Colombia , uno de los últimos destinos costeros del Caribe colombiano donde la naturaleza y el desarrollo conviven en equilibrio.
Con acceso directo a la playa y visuales sin obstáculos hacia el mar Caribe , Ika Mare redefine el concepto de vivir frente al océano.
El proyecto fue diseñado por el arquitecto Fernando De la Vega y desarrollado por Constructora Ika SAS , con el respaldo fiduciario de Alianza Fiduciaria .

La torre cuenta con 21 pisos y ofrece apartamentos desde 39 m² hasta 177 m² , distribuidos en tipologías que van desde suites compactas hasta amplios apartamentos de 3 alcobas , pensados para distintos perfiles de comprador: inversionistas, familias, parejas y compradores de segunda vivienda vacacional.
Este exlcusivo proyecto es desarrollado por Constructora Ika, con el respaldo de: Residere, Mavig, Conterra, Valdan y Area Capital.

Lo que distingue a Ika Mare de otros proyectos en la región es su ubicación estratégica: está a tan solo 5 minutos del Aeropuerto Internacional Simón Bolívar , en un sector tranquilo y reservado, con playas aún vírgenes.
Todos los apartamentos cuentan con balcón con vista al mar , diseño bioclimático que aprovecha la ventilación natural y acabados de alto estándar.

Las zonas comunes superan los 9.000 m² e incluyen piscina para adultos y niños, Wellness Spa con sauna y turco , gimnasio con vista al mar, bar y restaurante frente a la playa, lobby de doble altura, zona de coworking, teatrino, minimarket, juegos infantiles, cancha múltiple y living garden.
Una oferta de amenidades comparable a la de los mejores resorts del Caribe, diseñada para ser habitada de forma permanente o vacacional.

Para los inversionistas inmobiliarios , Ika Mare representa una oportunidad única: Santa Marta es la ciudad de mayor crecimiento turístico de Colombia , con alta demanda de arriendo vacacional y un mercado de finca raíz en plena valorización.
Un apartamento frente al mar en el Caribe colombiano , con gestión de arriendo y operación hotelera, ofrece retornos superiores al promedio del mercado.
Ika Mare no es solo un lugar para vivir.

Es una experiencia de vida conectada con el Caribe , donde cada detalle arquitectónico —desde las terrazas con barandas de vidrio hasta las fachadas curvas que dialogan con el oleaje— está pensado para que el mar sea protagonista del día a día.

¿Dónde queda exactamente el proyecto Ika Mare?
Ika Mare se ubica en el sector Costa Azul, Santa Marta, Colombia, sobre la línea de playa del Mar Caribe.
Está a 5 minutos del Aeropuerto Internacional Simón Bolívar y próximo al Centro Comercial Zazué y al Hotel Costa Azul Beach.
¿Qué tipos de apartamentos tiene Ika Mare?
El proyecto ofrece cuatro tipologías: Suites de 39–40 m², apartamentos de 1 alcoba + estudio de 60–67 m², apartamentos de 2 alcobas de 86–91 m², y apartamentos de 3 alcobas de 110–177 m².
Todos cuentan con balcón y vistas al mar.
¿Cuántos pisos tiene la torre Ika Mare?
Ika Mare tiene 21 pisos de apartamentos residenciales, más un sótano con parqueaderos y áreas de spa, gimnasio y acceso a playa, y una planta baja con todas las amenidades sociales y recreativas.
¿Es un buen proyecto para invertir en finca raíz vacacional?
Sí.
Santa Marta es el destino turístico de mayor crecimiento en Colombia.
Ika Mare ofrece apartamentos con alta demanda de arriendo vacacional, ubicación beachfront, y una operación de amenidades que facilita la gestión del activo.
Las suites y apartamentos de 1 alcoba son ideales para inversión.
¿Quién diseñó y construye Ika Mare?
El diseño arquitectónico es del arquitecto De la Vega.
El proyecto lo desarrolla Constructora Ika SAS, con promotores como Conterra, Mavig, ResidereR, Area Capital, Inversiones Valdan y LaHaus.
La fiducia es manejada por Alianza Fiduciaria.
¿Los apartamentos tienen vista directa al mar Caribe?
Todos los apartamentos de Ika Mare tienen balcón con vista al mar.
El proyecto está diseñado con fachadas orientadas hacia el Caribe para maximizar las visuales, la luz natural y la ventilación cruzada en cada unidad.
¿Cuáles son las amenidades disponibles en Ika Mare?

Ika Mare cuenta con más de 9.000 m² de zonas comunes: piscinas para adultos y niños, Wellness Spa con sauna y turco, gimnasio, bar, restaurante, lobby de doble altura, coworking, teatrino, minimarket, juegos infantiles, parque infantil, cancha múltiple y living garden.
¿Cómo puedo contactar al equipo de ventas de Ika Mare?
Puedes contactar al equipo de ventas por correo electrónico a ventas@ikabeach.com, o llamar a los teléfonos (+57) 318 586 3849 / (+57) 317 6424682 / (+57) 317 6397635 / (+57) 316 0561506.
¿Qué hace especial el sector Costa Azul en Santa Marta?
Costa Azul es un sector residencial tranquilo, con playas aún poco intervenidas, vegetación tropical y acceso directo al mar Caribe.
Su ubicación está fuera del ruido del centro urbano pero cerca del aeropuerto, lo que lo convierte en uno de los sectores más codiciados para vivir y vacacionar en Santa Marta.
¿Qué tamaño tienen los apartamentos más grandes de Ika Mare?
Los apartamentos más grandes son el N° 10 y N° 11, con 177 m² construidos y 3 alcobas, 3.5 baños, closet, balcón de 11 metros de frente y mirador.
También está el apartamento N° 3, de 164 m², con 3 alcobas, 4 baños, vestier y comedor independiente.

The new 120-room resort is located along La Sagesse Bay on Grenada ’s southeastern coast, includes a spa, wellness retreat and family-friendly programming on more than 20,000 square feet of versatile indoor and outdoor event space.
The resort features include five distinctive dining options, a world-class spa, state-of-the-art fitness facilities and an expansive pool and beach club.
Active travellers can enjoy pickleball and padel, Pilates sessions and the resort’s gym, while younger guests can play, create and discover through thoughtfully curated activities at Planet Trekkers.

The rooftop venue will also host “Our Island, Our New Year,” a New Year’s Eve celebration aimed at the Grenadian community, with music and comfort-food dishes to welcome 2027.

The first two towers, 27 floors each, have already been inaugurated: The Residences, with four units per floor, and The Mansions, with only two, for a total of 150 residences ranging from 190 to 580 m² .
Arquitectonica's undulating design, under the Italian maison's seal, engages with the bay from an elevated site of more than 75.000 m² .
The masterplan includes four towers, and the Maldonado Board has already authorized a new one of 100 meters, confirming that the complex keeps growing.
If you're drawn to branded luxury with calm sea views, this is the undisputed icon of the area.
Units and typologies The complex's 150 residences range from 190 to 580 m² , with floor plans that favor glazed façades facing the bay and deep terraces that function as outdoor living rooms.

In The Residences, the four units per floor allow flexible configurations of three and four en-suite bedrooms; in The Mansions, the two residences per floor reach house-like dimensions, with full staff quarters and double circulation.
The plans published by the project show living rooms of exceptional proportions, kitchens with integrated islands, and master suites with walk-in closets and marble bathrooms.
It's the large-footprint, internationally branded format that defined the top tier of Parada 17, facing the most celebrated sunsets of la Mansa.

The concept mirrors the experience of Miami's Fendi Château: sculptural architecture, interiors curated under the seal of the Roman maison founded in 1925 —now part of the LVMH group— and a level of detail that turns every common area into a design piece.
The Residences has four units per floor and The Mansions just two, guaranteeing open views and privacy in every orientation.
The elevated site of more than 75.000 m² completes the setting with gardens framing the sunsets over the calm sea.
The investment Fendi Château is the only branded residence of the Italian maison in South America, a scarcity attribute that in comparable markets keeps resale values above the area average.

The first two towers are already open and occupied, which removes construction risk, and the four-tower masterplan keeps expanding: in 2024 the Maldonado Departmental Board approved an exception to add a new tower of 100 meters within the complex.
For the buyer, that means joining an established development with room for appreciation still ahead.
The developer is Grupo Château of the Grosskopf family, with a proven track record in Miami and a history of landmark beachfront projects.

La entrega está prevista para 2030 Micaela Mura Redactora de Negocios Publicado el 25 de Septiembre de 2026 11:07 + Agregar El Cronista en abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña En esta noticia Cómo será el megaproyecto de u$s 450 millones en el ex Tiro Federal Un complejo con más de 7500 metros cuadrados de amenities La transformación de la zona Landmark Developments avanza con uno de sus proyectos inmobiliarios más grandes en la Ciudad de Buenos Aires.
La desarrolladora levanta tres torres en Núñez , frente al Chateau Libertador y a metros del Parque de la Innovación, con una inversión de u$s 450 millones.
Udaondo se levanta en la intersección de Avenida del Libertador y Udaondo y tendrá 165.000 metros cuadrados construidos .
Las obras comenzaron hace 20 meses y la entrega está prevista para fines de 2030.
Puerto Madero .

Dolce&Gabbana llega al real estate argentino: un referente de la City construirá su torre de u$s 160 millones abre en nueva pestaña “Más del 30% del desarrollo ya fue vendido” , explicó Alejandro Furst , CEO de Landmark Developments , a El Cronista.
Hoy, los precios superan los u$s 8000 por m2 .
Los valores se ubican incluso por encima de los que se registran en Puerto Madero .
A modo de referencia, el precio promedio de venta en ese barrio supera los u$s 6100 por m2 , según el último relevamiento de Zonaprop.
El proyecto comenzó a tomar forma en 2018 , cuando el grupo, a través del Fideicomiso Buenos Aires Landmark, compró en una subasta pública el terreno del ex Tiro Federal por u$s 150 millones.
Fue el primero en desembarcar en el Parque de la Innovación y se quedó con el lote de mayor superficie.
Cuando se anunció Udaondo, la inversión total prevista era de u$s 330 millones , de los cuales u$s 150 millones correspondían a la compra de la tierra y más de u$s 180 millones a la construcción .
Desde entonces, el desembolso previsto fue actualizado hasta el monto actual.
Real estate .

Lo llaman “el triángulo del nuevo lujo porteño” y desafía a Puerto Madero con departamentos de hasta u$s 12.000 el m2 abre en nueva pestaña Cómo será el megaproyecto de u$s 450 millones en el ex Tiro Federal Udaondo tendrá tres torres de unos 100 metros de altura , denominadas Río Norte, Río Sur y Ciudad.
Las dos primeras concentrarán los departamentos de mayor superficie, mientras que la tercera tendrá las tipologías más chicas.
En las Torres Río habrá departamentos de entre 200 y 700 m2, con dos, tres y cuatro dormitorios .
Todas las habitaciones serán en suite y las propiedades tendrán dependencia.
En los pisos más altos estarán los departamentos de mayor superficie, con terraza privada, parrilla y pileta propia .
La Torre Ciudad, en tanto, tendrá departamentos de entre 65 y 160 m2, con opciones de dos y tres ambientes .
Entre las tipologías habrá unidades de alrededor de 75 m2, con una habitación en suite, living comedor y cocina.
Con los valores que maneja actualmente el proyecto, un departamento de 70 m2 ronda los u$s 560.000, mientras que los penthouses se ubican por arriba de los u$s 7 millones.
Para la compra, la desarrolladora ofrece un anticipo del 30% y 48 cuotas .
Un complejo con más de 7500 metros cuadrados de amenities De los 165.000 m2 que tendrá, más de 7500 m2 estarán destinados a espacios comunes.
El proyecto contará además con 900 cocheras.
Entre esos espacios habrá un gimnasio de 1600 m2, una pileta de 50 metros y un área de coworking de 450 m2 .
También se proyectaron salones de usos múltiples, cavas y sectores destinados a chicos y adolescentes.
Cada una de las tres torres tendrá una pileta exterior con parrillas, mientras que uno de los edificios contará con un rooftop de uso compartido.
El proyecto sumará además espacios para recibir paquetes de compras online y pedidos de supermercado, con un sector refrigerado destinado a estos últimos.
También habrá un área para mascotas.
El diseño arquitectónico está a cargo del estudio Aisenson, responsable también de proyectos como Paseo Gigena, Le Parc Puerto Madero y Catalinas Río.
La transformación de la zona Udaondo no es el único proyecto que avanza en esta parte de Núñez.
El Parque de la Innovación y el corredor de Avenida del Libertador concentraron en los últimos años nuevas inversiones inmobiliarias.
Sancor Seguros y HIT construyen PI Buenos Aires , un complejo de 22.000 m2 que demandará una inversión de u$s 100 millones .
Las obras comenzaron en marzo y la finalización está prevista para fines de 2028.
u$s 200 millones .
El nuevo Núñez crece frente a River: así es la mega torre con rooftop y skybar en un predio icónico abre en nueva pestaña Sancor había comprado la parcela en 2020 por u$s 11,9 millones.
El terreno tiene 1800 m2 y fue adjudicado mediante una subasta dentro del predio del ex Tiro Federal.
La aseguradora tiene además otros dos lotes, donde prepara un hotel de una cadena internacional de cerca de 12.000 m2.
Sobre Avenida del Libertador también se concretó otra operación a fines de 2025.
Raghsa, la desarrolladora de las torres Le Parc, pagó u$s 73 millones por un terreno de 5800 m2 ubicado en Libertador 7055, frente al Chateau Libertador.
El lote tiene capacidad para construir aproximadamente 75.500 m2.
Aunque el vendedor no fue informado oficialmente cuando se conoció la operación, en el mercado señalaron a Estrella Seguros, la compañía que comparten Gerardo Werthein y Rodolfo D’Onofrio.
Raghsa ya tiene otros desarrollos en Núñez, entre ellos el Centro Empresarial Libertador, de 100.000 m2, y el Centro Empresarial Núñez, de 50.000 m2.
Además, avanza con otro proyecto de unos 50.000 m2 en Avenida del Libertador y Manuela Pedraza.

Rising 30 stories, the project marks Pendry’s first hotel and residential development in Tennessee.

The building features architecture by Nashville-based ESa and interiors by Post Company , offering 146 private residences designed with expansive layouts, high-end finishes, and views of the Nashville skyline.
“The debut of Pendry Residences Nashville is an exciting moment for us,” said Robin Kennedy , Executive Vice President and Chief Development Officer of Montage International.

“Nashville has an energy and creativity that fits perfectly with our brand, and we look forward to welcoming owners to a residential experience that reflects both the spirit of the city and the Pendry lifestyle.” Pendry Residences Nashville 30th Floor Conservatory © Binyan Studios Private residences with hotel-level amenities The residences occupy the upper floors of Pendry Nashville and combine the privacy of home with the amenities of a full-service hotel.

Homeowners will have access to a dedicated residential staff and a suite of private amenities, including a rooftop pool, speakeasy with golf simulator, whiskey lounge, billiards salon, fitness center, and pet spa.
Owners will also have access to Pendry Nashville’s hotel offerings, such as destination dining, rooftop spaces, and Spa Pendry’s wellness programs.
Residences range from one to four bedrooms, including ten penthouses.
Interiors include Italian-crafted cabinetry, Gaggenau appliances, and quartzite countertops.
Primary bathrooms feature Calacatta Rubino marble and custom oak vanities, while secondary baths incorporate French Vanilla and Green Lily marbles.
Select homes include wine refrigerators and outdoor living areas.

Pendry Residences Nashville Primary Bedroom © Binyan Studios The tower’s signature residence, The Paseo Penthouse, occupies the 30th floor and offers 5,993 square feet of interior space with an additional 1,055-square-foot private terrace and dedicated elevator access.
“We’re thrilled to introduce Pendry Residences Nashville to Tennessee,” said Maranda Blanton , Co-Founder and Managing Director of Redeavor Group.

“This is a unique opportunity to own a home that combines Pendry’s signature design and service with the energy and culture of Paseo South Gulch.” A cornerstone of Paseo South Gulch Pendry Nashville anchors SomeraRoad’s five-acre Paseo South Gulch neighborhood, which integrates historic buildings with new mixed-use developments.
The district features dining, wellness, and retail destinations including Equinox, Next Health, The Catbird Seat, and Carter Vintage Guitars.
“Our vision for the Paseo South Gulch has always been to create Nashville’s most exciting and dynamic neighborhood,” said Ian Ross , Founder and Managing Principal of SomeraRoad.

“With the launch of sales at Pendry Residences Nashville, we are proud to further that vision in a way that establishes Pendry as an unprecedented new benchmark for hospitality and luxury living in Nashville.” Construction is underway, with completion expected in 2027.

Vanderbilt Residences Condado Sixty-six residences at 1149 Ashford Avenue, in a tower rising about 250 feet over Condado.
Vanderbilt Residences stands at the corner of Ashford Avenue and Earle Street in Condado, San Juan.
At 22 stories and 250 feet it is the tallest residential building in the metro area, and at $260 million it is the largest single residential investment Condado has seen.
Who is behind Vanderbilt Residences?
Who is behind it matters here.
The project is owned outright by John Paulson, who took full control in March 2025 by acquiring his former partner's stake and ending the litigation that had shadowed the development.
Paulson & Co.
also owns the Condado Vanderbilt and La Concha hotels next door, so the party operating the neighborhood's two landmark hotels is the same one delivering this building.
Architecture is by SB Architects, the firm behind the St.
Regis Bahia Beach and the Ritz-Carlton Reserve at Dorado Beach.
Interiors are by Hirsch Bedner Associates.
How many residences does Vanderbilt Residences Condado have?
The building holds 66 units: 50 residences for sale and 16 hotel keys, from one to five bedrooms.
Deliveries have begun and the developer has announced full completion for 2027.
Why are there no Vanderbilt closings in the MLS yet?

What a buyer should understand before comparing prices: more than half of the 50 residences were already sold as of the developer's last public update, and yet not one Vanderbilt closing appears in Stellar MLS.
That is not weak demand.
It is how preconstruction works.
The sale is a contract; the closing, with its public recorded price, happens at delivery.
Until the building is handed over it has no closed comparables of its own.
How does Vanderbilt compare with the rest of Condado?
That is the most useful thing to know here.
Condado closed 60 sales in 2026 at a median of $852,500, and only one of them cleared $5 million.
Vanderbilt is not priced against that set.
It opened a tier Condado did not previously have, and a new tier does not retroactively revalue the buildings around it in either direction.
We are not the listing brokerage for this building.
We represent buyers in it: which units are genuinely available, what has gone to contract, and what to verify before you sign.
Sixty-six residences at 1149 Ashford Avenue, on the corner of Earle Street in Condado, in a tower rising roughly 250 feet over the Atlantic, the Condado Lagoon and the San Juan skyline.

According to reporting from June 2026, 50 of the 66 units are for sale as residences and 16 are designated for full-time tourism use — worth understanding before you buy, because it shapes who your neighbours are.
About 25,000 square feet of amenity space, including a 75-foot infinity pool.
Available now: eight residences Asking runs $1,750 to $2,750 per square foot, median $2,070.
That is the highest rate of any building we track in Puerto Rico — The Bristol, four blocks west on the same avenue, asks $910 to $1,960, and The Isles at Dorado Beach tops out at $2,280.
Units 1003 and 1903 are the same plan, 3,575 square feet, nine floors apart: $6,350,000 against $7,150,000.
Units 902 and 1602 are the same plan too, 3,965 square feet, seven floors apart: $9,125,000 against $9,520,000.
On this tower the asking price moves about 1.4 percent per floor.
What is for sale at Vanderbilt Residences in Condado, Puerto Rico?
Sixty-six residences at 1149 Ashford Avenue, on the corner of Earle Street in Condado.

Asking prices run from $1,750 to $2,750 per square foot with a median of $2,070, the highest rate of any building we track in Puerto Rico, and first deliveries began in 2026, so what remains is finite rather than a full release.

One distinction worth making before you search: the Condado Vanderbilt Hotel is a different property at a different address, and most searches for Condado Vanderbilt return the hotel rather than this building.
The developer has already raised prices twice This is not an estimate, it is the building’s own price history.
Residence 904 launched at $3,995,000 and asks $5,645,000 today — 41 percent higher.
Residence 1204 launched at $4,420,000 and asks $6,075,000 — 37 percent.
Residence 1602 has moved up as well.
A developer prices that way while a building is selling through, and the schedule is finite: first deliveries began in 2026 and the remaining inventory is what you see in the table above.
The window to choose from the full floor plate — your line, your floor, your view — is while the building is still completing, not after.
Once a tower closes out, you buy whatever the first owners decide to resell, at whatever they decide to ask.
If Vanderbilt is on your list, the useful conversation is now.
We will walk you through what is genuinely available, what is already spoken for, and how the floors compare.

We keep that record ourselves, closing by closing — sixty-nine closings between January and October 2026, at a median of $630 a square foot — and we will walk any Vanderbilt plan against what the avenue has actually paid before you write a number.

On the pristine shores of South Eleuthera, Cotton Bay Holdings Limited has broken ground on the Ritz-Carlton Reserve Residences, marking a historic milestone for one of the Caribbean’s most exclusive branded residential and hotel resort offerings.

This hotel and residences project, under the prestigious Ritz-Carlton Reserve brand, promises to deliver elegant living with a focus on sustainability, cultural preservation, complete with luxurious and unparalleled design.
Ritz-Carlton Reserve Residences Cotton Bay The project features 97 Ritz-Carlton Reserve branded residences, offering discerning owners an unmatched living experience.
Designed in the same unique architectural style of the resort, each privately owned residence will offer refined design and a one of a kind luxury experience for owners.
These residences, comprising three to five bedroom luxury private pool villas, blend sophisticated architecture with the natural splendour of South Eleuthera.

Designed for those seeking a private retreat, the branded residences provide access to world-class amenities, including signature restaurants, a lavish spa and wellness sanctuary, swimming pools, and an 18-hole championship golf course crafted by Robert Trent Jones II.

Each luxury branded villa for sale will be a testament to the Ritz-Carlton Reserve’s commitment to intuitive service, native design, and a deep connection to the local environment, delivering a one of a kind residential lifestyle for owners.

The resort will integrate with Eleuthera’s breathtaking landscape, and will offer a highly personalized leisure experience rooted in human connection, local culture, and heritage.

Luis Carlos Sarmiento Angulo, owner of Cotton Bay Holdings Limited , along with his family, the Cotton Bay team, members of the Bahamas Ministry of Tourism, Investments & Aviation and stakeholders from the local and business community.

Prime Minister Davis commended the project’s sustainable vision, while Deputy Prime Minister Cooper highlighted its alignment with The Bahamas’ thriving tourism sector.
The resort and residences are poised to serve as an economic catalyst for Eleuthera, creating significant job opportunities, supporting local businesses, and driving long-term development.
